items.title: 脫歐十年後再一次公投？英國首相柏南拋「重回歐盟」選項
items.title_en: Another Brexit Referendum Ten Years On? UK Prime Minister Burnham Puts 'Re‑joining the EU' on the Table
paras: 英國首相柏南(Andy Burnham)在工黨年度大會及後續採訪中指出，英國脫歐已造成「弊大於利」的後果，並宣布政府將著手評估英國與歐盟未來關係的多種長期選項。柏南更坦言，工黨未來的競選宣言中「有可能」納入重新決定是否加入歐盟的公投選項。
柏南透露，政府預計在11月的英國與歐盟峰會前提出相關評估。他所列出的政策路徑包括維持現狀、借鑑前財相歐斯本(George Osborne)提出的關稅同盟方案、採納自由民主黨主張的單一市場，或是「走到底」完全重新加入歐盟。
柏南強調，雖然當前並非立即推動公投的時機，但英國若不對最大貿易夥伴做出長期定位，將無法突破發展瓶頸。他同時指出，脫歐反而削弱了英國在移民與邊境控管上的合作效率。
倫敦市長汗(Sadiq Khan)對此公開表達支持，引述柏南「希望來自誠實」的說法，痛批脫歐是英國歷史上「災難性的國家自我傷害」。 汗引述倫敦市政府的研究數據指出，脫歐已導致倫敦經濟規模縮減約300億英鎊、全國減少近200萬個工作機會。
他強烈呼籲工黨政府應在本屆國會任期內率先重返關稅同盟與單一市場，並在2029年大選前向選民論述重新加入歐盟的必要性。
「政府效率智庫」(Institute for Government)研究員Jill Rutter分析，柏南的立場與前首相施凱爾(Keir Starmer)過去畫出的紅線有顯著切割，正式將「重返歐盟」議題帶回政治主流。
然而，此舉也招致政界強烈交鋒，保守黨副黨魁Alex Burghart批評工黨企圖揭開歷史傷口以掩蓋經濟失策，改革黨(Reform UK)副黨魁Richard Tice指責政府意圖從後門向布魯塞爾妥協，自由民主黨黨魁Ed Davey則喊話柏南應停止空談，立即就單一市場與關稅同盟開展實質談判。
paras_en: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham told the Labour Party’s annual conference and in subsequent interviews that Brexit has produced "more harm than benefit" and announced the government will begin assessing a range of long‑term options for the UK’s future relationship with the EU. Burnham also admitted that a future Labour election manifesto could "potentially" include a referendum on whether to re‑join the EU.

Burnham said the government aims to present its assessment before the UK‑EU summit in November. The policy pathways he outlined range from maintaining the status quo, borrowing former chancellor George Osborne’s customs‑union proposal, adopting the Liberal Democrats’ single‑market option, or "going all the way" by fully re‑entering the EU.

Burnham stressed that, while now is not the moment to launch a referendum, the UK cannot overcome its development bottlenecks without a long‑term positioning on its biggest trading partner. He also noted that Brexit has actually weakened cooperation on immigration and border control.

London Mayor Sadiq Khan publicly voiced his support, quoting Burnham’s claim that "hope comes from honesty" and condemning Brexit as a "catastrophic act of self‑inflicted harm" in British history. Khan cited research from the London city government showing that Brexit has shrunk London’s economy by about £30 billion and cut nearly two million jobs nationwide.

He urged a Labour government to be the first in this parliamentary term to return to the customs union and single market, and to explain to voters the necessity of re‑joining the EU before the 2029 election.

Institute for Government researcher Jill Rutter analysed that Burnham’s stance marks a clear break from former Labour leader Keir Starmer’s red‑line, formally bringing the "return to the EU" issue back into the political mainstream.

The move has sparked fierce backlash in politics: Conservative deputy leader Alex Burghart accused Labour of reopening old wounds to mask economic missteps, Reform UK deputy leader Richard Tice charged the government with trying to sneak a compromise with Brussels, and Liberal Democrat leader Ed Davey urged Burnham to stop talking and start concrete negotiations on the single market and customs union.

items.title: 明年能產多少油？美伊戰事打亂擴產 OPEC+產能評估被迫延期
items.title_en: How Much Oil Can Be Produced Next Year? US‑Iran Conflict Disrupts Expansion Plans, OPEC+ Capacity Assessment Delayed
paras: 美伊戰爭打亂中東石油擴產計畫，也使主要產油國未來的供應能力更難估算。兩名知情人士向《路透》透露，OPEC+原訂9月底完成、作為2027年原油產量配額協商依據的產能評估已延後，其中一人表示，目前預計11月中旬才能完成。
OPEC+由石油輸出國組織(OPEC)、俄羅斯及其他盟國組成，去年底決定對所有成員進行產能評估，以便在制定2027年配額前，掌握各國可持續生產的原油規模。OPEC尚未立即回應置評要求。
這次評估旨在透過獨立調查，更新各成員的可持續產能數據，而這是協商產量目標的重要依據。然而，美國與以色列對伊朗的戰爭，導致部分OPEC+國家原本可提高產能的計畫延宕，讓預定新增產能能否如期到位充滿變數，也使評估所依據的假設面臨調整。
消息人士表示，並非所有成員都已提交評估所需資料，但未透露哪些國家尚未完成。擴產時程不明，加上資料缺漏，使這項原本就涉及政治角力的工作更加複雜。
評估結果可能直接影響各國未來可生產的原油數量。若一國被認定的產能較低，可能面臨下調配額的壓力；已擴大產能的國家，則可能要求取得更高配額。因此，擴產計畫延誤不僅影響供應潛力，也可能改變成員在配額談判中的立場與籌碼。
配額分配一直是OPEC+內部的敏感議題。阿拉伯聯合大公國先前曾要求提高配額，以反映其持續增加的產能，但已於今年5月退出聯盟。
伊拉克同樣尋求提高配額。消息人士6月曾向《路透》透露，伊拉克也考慮退出OPEC。在成員爭取更大生產空間之際，產能評估延後，為2027年的配額協商增添不確定性。
paras_en: The US‑Iran war has disrupted Middle East oil expansion plans, making it harder to gauge future supply capacity of major producers. Two sources told Reuters that OPEC+’s capacity assessment, originally due by the end of September as the basis for 2027 crude production quota negotiations, has been postponed, with one source saying it is now expected to be completed by mid‑November.

OPEC+, which consists of the Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC), Russia and other allies, decided at the end of last year to conduct a capacity assessment of all members so that, before setting 2027 quotas, it can understand each country’s sustainable crude output. OPEC has not responded to requests for comment.

The assessment aims to update each member’s sustainable capacity figures through an independent survey, providing a key basis for negotiating production targets. However, the US‑Israel war against Iran has delayed some OPEC+ countries’ plans to increase capacity, creating uncertainty over whether the planned additional capacity will materialise and forcing a revision of the assumptions underlying the assessment.

Sources said not all members have submitted the data required for the assessment, but did not specify which countries are still pending. The unclear expansion timeline and missing data make an already politically charged task even more complex.

The assessment results could directly affect how much crude each country can produce in the future. If a country is judged to have lower capacity, it may face pressure to have its quota cut; countries that have expanded capacity may push for higher quotas. Thus, delays in expansion not only affect supply potential but could also shift members’ bargaining positions and leverage in quota talks.

Quota allocation has always been a sensitive issue within OPEC+. The United Arab Emirates previously asked for a higher quota to reflect its ongoing capacity increase, but withdrew from the alliance in May of this year.

Iraq is also seeking a higher quota. Sources told Reuters in June that Iraq was considering leaving OPEC. As members vie for more production space, the delayed capacity assessment adds uncertainty to the 2027 quota negotiations.

items.title: 普丁預言：很快所有人都得開中國車
items.title_en: Putin Predicts: Soon Everyone Will Drive Chinese Cars
paras: 俄羅斯總統普丁1日（周四）在「瓦爾代」國際辯論俱樂部全體會議上表示，由於歐洲汽車市場陷入深度衰退，很快所有車主都可能換開中國車。
普丁說：「歐洲汽車工業在哪裡？企業正在關閉，我們很快都會開上中國車，是好是壞我不知道，但便宜，且品質好。」
普丁駁斥西方國家對中國車「產能過剩」的指責，並提醒市場的基本原則——最終結果永遠由消費者需求決定。
他強調，如今不僅歐洲汽車工業處於深度危機和嚴重困境，歐洲冶金、化工和製藥工業也是如此。
「瓦爾代」國際辯論俱樂部是一個由外國和俄羅斯的政治學、經濟學、歷史學和國際關係領域的頂尖專家組成的協會。
paras_en: Russian President Vladimir Putin said on Thursday, the 1st, at a plenary meeting of the Valday International Debate Club that, due to a deep recession in the European car market, all car owners may soon switch to Chinese vehicles.

Putin stated: "Where is the European automotive industry? Companies are shutting down, and we will soon be driving Chinese cars. I don’t know if it’s good or bad, but they are cheap and of good quality."
Putin dismissed Western accusations of "overcapacity" in Chinese car production and reminded that the basic market principle is that the final outcome is always determined by consumer demand.

He emphasized that not only is the European automotive industry in a deep crisis and severe trouble, but the European metallurgy, chemical and pharmaceutical sectors are likewise facing similar challenges.
The Valday International Debate Club is an association composed of top foreign and Russian experts in political science, economics, history and international relations.

items.title: 聯合國：物流中斷與氣候衝擊推升 9月全球食品價格創近4年新高
items.title_en: UN: Logistics Disruptions and Climate Shocks Push September Global Food Prices to Near‑Four‑Year High
paras: 聯合國糧食及農業組織(FAO)發表最新報告指出，受物流運輸受阻與天候疑慮影響，全球食品價格在 9 月升至近4年來最高。
追蹤一籃子大宗食品國際價格變化的 FAO 食品價格指數，9 月平均達到 136.0 點，高於 8 月修正後的 134.0 點，創下自 2022 年 11 月以來的最高紀錄。
針對價格漲勢，FAO 主任經濟學家Maximo Torero 指出：「我們看到全球大宗商品價格出現持續且日益廣泛的漲勢，荷姆茲海峽與黑海的運輸受阻與氣候衝擊相結合，對能源、運輸及關鍵食品大宗商品造成壓力。」
Torero 進一步警告：「若這些壓力持續存在，將很快轉嫁至消費者食品價格上，特別是高度依賴食品與能源進口的國家。」
從各類大宗商品來看，砂糖價格指數較 8 月大幅上漲 6.1%，呈現連續第三個月上揚，主因惡劣天候威脅主要產區供給；對嚴重聖嬰現象(El Niño)的疑慮更將國際糖價推升至 18 個月新高。
穀物價格基準月增 5.1%，除了黑海穀物貿易受阻外，美國玉米產量前景下滑加劇壓力；先前戰爭導致黑海貿易崩潰，曾推動小麥期貨衝上三年高點。植物油價格微幅上升 0.9%，主因需求強勁及東南亞聖嬰現象風險帶動棕櫚油走揚。
相對地，肉類指數則小幅下跌 1.1%，反映家禽價格走低，部分與歐盟新進口規定生效導致需求下降有關。
此外，FAO 對 2026 年全球穀物產量預測維持在 29.79 億公噸，雖較前一年高點減少 2.1%，但仍為史上第二大收成。然而，受黑海航運受限影響，小麥與玉米出口預期遭調降，FAO 將 2026/27 年度全球穀物貿易量預測下修 0.7%。
paras_en: The United Nations Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) released its latest report stating that, due to logistics bottlenecks and weather concerns, global food prices rose in September to the highest level in almost four years.

Tracking a basket of major international food commodity prices, the FAO Food Price Index averaged 136.0 points in September, up from the revised 134.0 points in August, marking the highest reading since November 2022.

Regarding the price surge, FAO chief economist Maximo Torero said, "We are seeing a sustained and increasingly widespread rise in global commodity prices, with transport disruptions in the Hormuz Strait and the Black Sea combined with climate shocks putting pressure on energy, transport and key food commodities."
Torero added a warning: "If these pressures persist, they will quickly be passed on to consumer food prices, especially in countries that are heavily dependent on food and energy imports."

Among bulk commodities, the sugar price index jumped 6.1% from August, marking a third consecutive month of gains, driven by severe weather threatening supply in major producing regions; concerns over a strong El Niño further lifted international sugar prices to an 18‑month high.

Grain prices rose 5.1% month‑on‑month, with Black Sea grain trade disruptions and a deteriorating outlook for U.S. corn output adding pressure; earlier war‑related Black Sea trade collapse had previously pushed wheat futures to a three‑year peak. Plant‑oil prices edged up 0.9%, mainly due to strong demand and El Niño‑related risk in Southeast Asia boosting palm‑oil prices.
Conversely, the meat index slipped 1.1%, reflecting lower poultry prices, partly linked to reduced demand after new EU import regulations took effect.

The FAO kept its 2026 global grain production forecast at 2.979 billion tonnes, a 2.1% drop from the previous year’s peak but still the second‑largest harvest on record. However, limited Black Sea shipping has led to downward revisions of wheat and corn export expectations, and the FAO trimmed its forecast for global grain trade in 2026/27 by 0.7%.

items.title: 川普祭柴油出口禁令威脅！歐盟研議釋出5000萬桶救油價
items.title_en: Trump Threatens Diesel Export Ban; EU Mulls Releasing 50 Million Barrels to Stabilize Prices
paras: 歐洲柴油價格飆升，美國又施壓釋出緊急庫存，歐盟正研議由法國提出的方案，釋出5,000萬桶柴油，並由國際能源署(IEA)成員國另外釋出5,000萬桶原油。歐洲各國也討論，是否要求美方承諾不單方面禁止柴油出口，作為同意釋出庫存的條件。
據《路透》報導，兩名知情人士透露，歐盟各國政府周五(2日)在電話會議中討論這項提案。在此之前，川普政府已要求法國、德國等歐洲大國動用緊急柴油庫存，否則美國可能祭出柴油出口禁令。一名消息人士指出，美方要求這些國家在20天內釋出1億桶柴油。
川普正考慮禁止美國柴油出口，以便在11月3日期中選舉前壓低國內燃料價格。這使歐洲面臨更大壓力：一方面需要抑制燃料成本飆升，另一方面也必須保留緊急儲備，因應美伊戰爭造成的供應中斷，以及波斯灣產油國供油前景的不確定性。法國財政與能源部尚未立即回應置評要求。
全球柴油供應目前受到多重因素衝擊。除了美伊戰爭干擾供應，烏克蘭攻擊造成俄羅斯多座煉油廠受損後，俄方也禁止燃料出口。消息人士另指出，中國煉油業者已暫停10月燃料出口，以充實國內庫存，進一步壓縮國際市場供應。
依歐盟統計局截至2025年5月的資料，法國提議釋出的5,000萬桶柴油，相當於歐盟柴油與輕柴油緊急庫存總量約17%，也約占歐盟全年相關燃料消費量的3%。
歐洲過去主要依賴俄羅斯與中東進口柴油，但近年對美國供應的依賴日益增加。因此，美國一旦禁止柴油出口，歐洲取得替代供應的壓力將進一步升高。
一名知情人士表示，歐盟各國在周五會議中討論，任何釋出柴油庫存的協議，是否都應以美方承諾不單方面實施柴油出口禁令為前提。目前尚未傳出各國已就法國提案達成協議。
該人士另指出，七大工業國集團(G7)領袖可能在周五下午舉行電話會議，討論後續措施。法國目前擔任G7輪值主席國。
IEA的32個成員國已於3月同意協調釋出4億桶戰略石油儲備，以因應美伊戰爭，規模為歷來最大。IEA執行長比羅爾(Fatih Birol)本周表示，成員國迄今已釋出約三分之二的原定數量。
paras_en: Europe’s diesel prices are soaring and the United States is again pressuring the release of emergency stocks. The EU is considering a French‑proposed plan to release 50 million barrels of diesel, while IEA member countries would release another 50 million barrels of crude oil. European governments are also debating whether to demand a U.S. pledge not to unilaterally ban diesel exports as a condition for agreeing to the stock releases.

According to Reuters, two informed sources said EU governments discussed the proposal in a conference call on Friday (the 2nd). Earlier, the Trump administration had asked major European powers such as France and Germany to tap emergency diesel reserves, warning that the U.S. might impose a diesel export ban. One source said the U.S. demanded that these countries release 100 million barrels of diesel within 20 days.

Trump is weighing a ban on U.S. diesel exports to push down domestic fuel prices ahead of the November 3 primary election. This puts Europe under greater strain: it must curb soaring fuel costs while preserving emergency reserves to cope with supply disruptions from the U.S.–Iran conflict and the uncertain outlook for oil supplies from the Persian Gulf. France’s finance and energy ministries have not responded to requests for comment.

Global diesel supply is currently hit by multiple factors. In addition to the U.S.–Iran war disrupting supplies, Russian refineries were damaged by Ukrainian attacks and Russia has banned fuel exports. Sources also note that Chinese refiners have halted October fuel exports to build domestic inventories, further tightening international market supply.

EU statistics as of May 2025 show that the 50 million barrels of diesel France proposes to release represent about 17 % of the EU’s total emergency diesel and light‑diesel stockpiles, roughly 3 % of the bloc’s annual consumption of related fuels.

Europe has traditionally relied on diesel imports from Russia and the Middle East, but its dependence on U.S. supplies has grown in recent years. Consequently, a U.S. diesel export ban would increase pressure on Europe to find alternative sources.

An informed source said EU ministers discussed at Friday’s meeting whether any agreement to release diesel stocks should be predicated on a U.S. commitment not to impose a unilateral diesel export ban. No agreement on the French proposal has been reported yet.
The source added that G7 leaders may hold a conference call on Friday afternoon to discuss follow‑up measures, with France currently holding the G7 rotating presidency.

IEA members, 32 countries, agreed in March to coordinate the release of 400 million barrels of strategic petroleum reserves in response to the U.S.–Iran war – the largest release ever. IEA Executive Director Fatih Birol said this week that members have so far released about two‑thirds of the planned amount.

items.title: 台積電加碼美國德州？經部表態協助全球布局 但核心技術「根留台灣」
items.title_en: TSMC Expands in Texas? Ministry of Economic Affairs Says It Will Help Global Layout but Core Technology Remains Firmly in Taiwan
paras: 針對媒體報導台積電（2330-TW）（TSM-US）將布局美國德州、擴大對美投資一事，經濟部今（2）日回應表示，台灣半導體產業實力強勁，在全球占據關鍵地位。在面對全球供應鏈韌性需求增加的背景下，政府尊重企業因應國際客戶需求、爭取更大國際商機所進行的全球多元布局。同時強調，台灣依然是全球最重要的半導體生產與研發基地，關鍵前瞻技術仍會堅定根留台灣。
業界傳出，台積電繼先前於美國亞利桑那州推動建廠計畫後，傳出規劃進一步將投資足跡延伸至德州，以深化在美國當地的半導體供應鏈能量。對此，經濟部指出，台積電目前公開宣布赴美投資累積金額為2650億美元，相關具體投資計畫仍以公司向外界說明為宜，經濟部也會持續與台積電保持密切溝通與互動，全力協助企業進行海內外布局並拓展國際市場。
隨著近年全球供應鏈重組壓力增加，半導體製造戰略地位顯著提升，台美兩國在半導體產業的合作也日益緊密。經濟部表示，台美已經簽訂台美投資MOU，進一步強化雙方戰略夥伴關係並加強產業合作，政府未來將針對台灣企業赴美投資提供更強化之協助，以順應國際趨勢並鞏固產業影響力。
經濟部同時強調，企業在布局全球的同時，台灣依然是全球最重要的半導體生產與研發基地，關鍵前瞻技術仍會堅定根留台灣。政府將會盡力協助企業在台灣持續擴大投資，確保台灣在半導體供應鏈中的核心優勢地位與科技實力。
paras_en: In response to media reports that TSMC (2330‑TW) (TSM‑US) will set up operations in Texas and increase its U.S. investment, the Ministry of Economic Affairs said today that Taiwan’s semiconductor industry is strong and occupies a critical global position. paras_en: The Taipei City Economic Development Bureau recently led 12 companies to shine at the 2026 Singapore Tech Week, setting up a "Smart Tech·Innovative Taipei" Taipei Pavilion. items.title_en: Huimin's subsidiary Huijia Water Wins "Chiayi County Expanded County Seat Recycled Water Plant BTO Project" with a NT$1.69 billion investment

The recycled‑water BTO project won by Huijia Water, a subsidiary of Huimin Industrial, is slated for a construction period of 1,195 calendar days, followed by a 15‑year operating term counted from the start of operations.

Huimin stated that Huijia must complete the construction and operation of the related facilities within the contractually agreed timeframe, provide performance guarantees for both the construction and operation phases, and fulfill obligations related to operational management, water‑quality standards, equipment maintenance, and asset transfer.

Huimin currently has a share capital of about NT$387 million. Its core business covers water resources and waste‑treatment services, including public sewage treatment plants, reclaimed water, seawater desalination, and drinking‑water facilities, as well as water‑infrastructure projects that have recently drawn public attention such as pumping stations and detention ponds. Huimin provides operation‑maintenance, construction, upgrade and engineering contracting services for these water‑resource projects.

Xinlu Investment Holding explained that the "Hsinchu City Ke‑Ya Water‑Resource Recovery Center Effluent Recycling and Reuse BTO Project" follows a BTO (build, transfer, operate) approach, encompassing the expansion of the Ke‑Ya water‑resource recovery center sewage‑treatment plant, the construction of a new reclaimed‑water plant, and related water‑intake, transmission and distribution facilities. Upon completion, the sewage‑treatment plant will have a total capacity of 70,000 cubic meters per day, and the reclaimed‑water system will be able to supply 40,000 tons of reclaimed water daily, primarily for the Baoshan Phase‑II park.

惠民指出，惠嘉應依投資契約約定期限完成相關設施的興建及營運，並提供興建期及營運期履約保證金，履行相關營運管理、水質標準、設備維護及資產轉移等義務。
惠民目前股本約 3.87 億元，惠民實業主要業務為水資源及廢棄物處理，水資源包含公共污水處理廠、再生水、海水淡化及淨水場，也包含近期受社會關注的水利工程，如抽水站、滯洪池等，這些水資源處理惠民實業提供操作維護以及興建、更新及工程承攬等服務。
而日前欣陸投控(3703-TW)旗下欣達環工也宣布，正式獲評為「新竹市客雅水資源回收中心放流水回收再利用BTO案」最優申請人，並已完成議約程序。本案預估投資金額約84.5億元，興建及特許期合計約18年6個月，建置再生水系統後，每日供應寶山二期園區4萬噸再生水。
欣陸投控指出，「新竹市客雅水資源回收中心放流水回收再利用BTO案」，採BTO，興建、移轉及營運）模式推動，主要包括客雅水資源回收中心污水處理廠擴建工程、再生水廠新建工程，以及相關取輸水與輸配水設施。完工後污水處理廠整體處理能力達70,000 CMD；再生水系統每日可供應4萬噸再生水，主要供應寶山二期園區使用。
paras_en: Environmental engineering and water services company Huimin Industrial (6971‑TW) announced today that its subsidiary Huijia Water has secured the "Chiayi County Expanded County Seat Recycled Water Plant BTO Project," which will use a Build‑Transfer‑Operate (BTO) model and is expected to involve an investment of NT$1.69 billion.

The recycled‑water BTO project won by Huijia Water, a subsidiary of Huimin Industrial, is slated for a construction period of 1,195 calendar days, followed by a 15‑year operating term counted from the start of operations.

Huimin stated that Huijia must complete the construction and operation of the related facilities within the contractually agreed timeframe, provide performance guarantees for both the construction and operation phases, and fulfill obligations related to operational management, water‑quality standards, equipment maintenance, and asset transfer.

Huimin currently has a share capital of about NT$387 million. Its core business covers water resources and waste‑treatment services, including public sewage treatment plants, reclaimed water, seawater desalination, and drinking‑water facilities, as well as water‑infrastructure projects that have recently drawn public attention such as pumping stations and detention ponds. Huimin provides operation‑maintenance, construction, upgrade and engineering contracting services for these water‑resource projects.

Earlier, Xinlu Investment Holding (3703‑TW) subsidiary XinDa Environmental Engineering announced that it had been formally selected as the top applicant for the "Hsinchu City Ke‑Ya Water‑Resource Recovery Center Effluent Recycling and Reuse BTO Project" and has completed the contract‑signing process. The project is estimated to require an investment of about NT$8.45 billion, with a combined construction and concession period of roughly 18 years and 6 months, and will supply 40,000 tons of reclaimed water per day to the Baoshan Phase‑II industrial park after the system is built.

Xinlu Investment Holding explained that the "Hsinchu City Ke‑Ya Water‑Resource Recovery Center Effluent Recycling and Reuse BTO Project" follows a BTO (build, transfer, operate) approach, encompassing the expansion of the Ke‑Ya water‑resource recovery center sewage‑treatment plant, the construction of a new reclaimed‑water plant, and related water‑intake, transmission and distribution facilities. Upon completion, the sewage‑treatment plant will have a total capacity of 70,000 cubic meters per day, and the reclaimed‑water system will be able to supply 40,000 tons of reclaimed water daily, primarily for the Baoshan Phase‑II park.

items.title: 鴻海攜手祥寶參展台北國際照顧博覽會 智慧長照三大場域啟動實證
items.title_en: Foxconn Partners with Xiangbao to Exhibit at Taipei International Care Expo, Launching Three Smart Long-Term Care Pilot Sites
paras: 鴻海(2317-TW)與祥寶尊榮長照集團於Cares Expo Taipei 2026台北國際照顧博覽會展出智慧長照合作成果，雙方於桃園寶之林、太原祥寶及怡德日照中心三大場域進行實證，驗證AI與健康數據融入日常照護流程的可行性。
雙方自2025年11月起推動智慧長照合作，導入智慧穿戴、AI運算、端雲整合及人機協作等技術，並合作重點並非單純導入智慧設備，而是從實際照護流程出發，觀察長者、照護人員及系統平台的使用需求，檢視健康數據與照護流程的串聯方式，並將場域累積的經驗作為後續產品及服務優化依據，逐步建立以數據、AI及人機協作為基礎的智慧長照模式。
在長者端，智慧穿戴讓健康管理從照護人員監測，逐步增加長者自主參與；在照護端，則透過個人化監測、異常資訊上報及數據整合，協助照護人員掌握長者狀況，讓AI支援照護工作，建立「Human + AI」人機協作模式。
此次展會現場也展示雙方智慧照護成果，包括CoDoctor Pro、CoDoctor Home、CoDoctor Watch及Nurabot護理協作機器人等，涵蓋智慧穿戴、軟硬體整合及端雲平台應用，從單一產品逐步走向整合型智慧長照解決方案。
祥寶尊榮長照集團今年適逢深耕長照40週年，並於展覽首日舉行40週年慶典暨開幕儀式，祥寶董事長林哲弘表示，真正的AI-Native Long Care並不是把AI放進長照，而是重新思考長照如何運作。未來祥寶將持續與鴻海深化合作，在更多長照場域累積實證經驗，推動智慧科技由單一產品走向平台解決方案，朝智慧醫養及AI原生長照發展。
paras_en: Foxconn (2317-TW) and Xiangbao Premium Long-Term Care Group showcased their smart long‑term care collaboration at Cares Expo Taipei 2026, demonstrating results from three pilot sites—Taoyuan Baozhilin, Taiyuan Xiangbao, and Yide Daycare Center—where they validated the feasibility of integrating AI and health data into everyday care processes.

Since November 2025, the two parties have been advancing a smart long‑term care partnership that introduces smart wearables, AI computing, edge‑cloud integration and human‑machine collaboration. The focus is not merely on deploying smart devices but on starting from actual care workflows, observing the needs of seniors, caregivers and the platform, examining how health data links with care processes, and using the accumulated field experience to refine future products and services, gradually building a data‑, AI‑ and human‑machine‑collaboration‑based smart care model.

For seniors, smart wearables shift health management from caregiver monitoring toward greater self‑participation; for caregivers, personalized monitoring, abnormal alerts and data integration help them keep track of seniors’ conditions, allowing AI to support caregiving and establishing a “Human + AI” collaboration model.

The expo also displayed the partners’ smart care achievements, including CoDoctor Pro, CoDoctor Home, CoDoctor Watch and the Nurabot nursing collaboration robot, covering smart wearables, hardware‑software integration and edge‑cloud platform applications, moving from single products toward integrated smart long‑term care solutions.

This year marks Xiangbao Premium Long‑Term Care Group’s 40th anniversary of deep involvement in long‑term care. On the opening day of the exhibition, a 40‑year celebration and ceremony were held. Chairman Lin Zhe‑hong said that true AI‑Native Long Care is not about merely inserting AI into care, but rethinking how care operates. Xiangbao will continue to deepen cooperation with Foxconn, gather more field evidence across additional care sites, and advance smart technology from isolated products to platform solutions, driving development toward smart medical‑nursing and AI‑native long‑term care.

items.title: 聚陽Q3營收創近6季最佳 累計營收重返正成長 Q4可望維持年增
items.title_en: Juyang Q3 Revenue Hits Best in Nearly Six Quarters, Cumulative Revenue Returns to Positive Growth; Q4 Expected to Maintain Year-over-Year Increase
paras: 成衣代工大廠聚陽(1477-TW)今(2)日公告9月營收29.3億元，月減17.5%、年增24%；第三季營收94.84億元，創近6季最佳，季增16.1%、年增6.7%；累計前9月營收265.46億元，年增0.2%，重返成長軌道。
聚陽表示，第三季營收表現符合公司預期，回到個位數年增；展望第四季，雖然戰爭未解、高油價及通膨等外部不確定因素仍在，但目前訂單能見度仍達年底，預計第四季業績可望維持年增表現，全年維持較去年成長的目標。
聚陽進一步指出，目前運動盤需求穩健，除了產品單價較高、毛利率較佳，客戶也陸續下急單，並進一步推升價格；隨著第四季至明年第一季進入運動盤傳統旺季，可望帶動營收表現。目前運動盤營收比重約5成，旺季可能提升至6成。
展望明年，聚陽持相對正向看法，主要是美國期中選舉落幕、戰爭因素也可望淡化，隨著負面因素影響逐漸消退，有助提振市場信心；另一方面，AI快速崛起，具備快速反應及彈性的供應商也較具優勢，這也是聚陽的強項。
paras_en: Garment OEM giant Juyang (1477-TW) announced today (2) September revenue of NT$2.93 billion, down 17.5% month‑on‑month, up 24% year‑on‑year; third‑quarter revenue of NT$9.484 billion, the best in almost six quarters, up 16.1% sequentially and 6.7% year‑on‑year; cumulative revenue for the first nine months of NT$26.546 billion, up 0.2% year‑on‑year, returning to growth.

Juyang said the Q3 revenue performance met company expectations, returning to single‑digit year‑over‑year growth; looking ahead to Q4, although external uncertainties such as the unresolved war, high oil prices and inflation remain, order visibility still extends to year‑end, and the company expects Q4 results to maintain year‑over‑year growth, keeping the full‑year growth target over last year.

Juyang further noted that demand for sports plates remains solid; besides higher product prices and better gross margins, customers are also placing urgent orders and further pushing up prices; with Q4 through Q1 of next year entering the traditional peak season for sports plates, revenue performance is expected to be boosted. Currently, sports‑plate revenue accounts for about 50% of total, which could rise to 60% in the peak season.

Looking to next year, Juyang remains relatively optimistic, mainly because the U.S. midterm elections have concluded and war‑related factors are expected to ease; as negative influences gradually recede, market confidence should improve. Moreover, the rapid rise of AI gives an edge to suppliers that can respond quickly and flexibly, which is a strength of Juyang.

items.title: 〈台幣〉亞幣轉強！逆勢翻升收31.83元 觀望美非農報告
items.title_en: TWD: Asian Currencies Strengthen! Defying Trend, Rises to 31.83, Awaiting US Nonfarm Payrolls
paras: 市場關注美國稍晚即將公布的非農就業數據，台北匯市整體交投轉趨冷清，新台幣兌美元今 (2) 日盤中一度貶破 31.9 元關卡，外資雙向進出，但整體亞幣偏升，尾盤在央行調節下，新台幣終場以31.83元作收，小升1.2分，為連 3 升，台北與元太外匯總成交值萎縮至 21.91 億美元。
台北股匯本周僅有四個交易日，由於美伊衝突未見緩解，使得美元本周較為強勢，新台幣兌美元累計貶值5分或0.16%，周線再度翻黑。
台股電子權值股今(2)日多無表態，早盤呈現震盪走勢，但被動元件、光通訊、PCB、矽晶圓等中小型股接棒演出，帶動大盤走揚，最高漲至48491.62點，距盤中歷史新高 48601.53 點僅差臨門一腳，終場漲 122.25 點，收 48475.74 點，仍寫收盤新高，成交量8981.74億元。外資今天買超台股 26.22 億元。
新台幣兌美元今天開盤價為 31.87 元，盤中一度貶近 1 角，最低來到 31.935 元，不過，為避免新台幣走勢與主要亞幣脫鉤太多，央行適時進場調節，帶動匯價由貶轉升，收在 31.83 元。
觀察主要貨幣今天表現，根據央行統計，韓元強升 1.13%，成為本日最強亞幣，日元亦勁揚 0.51%，星幣升值 0.15%，新台幣小升 0.04%，人民幣則因十一長假休市。
周三數據顯示，美國8月通膨增幅低於預期，且7月數據遭到下修，降低了市場對聯準會本月升息的預期。市場將焦點轉向美國勞工統計局 (BLS) 即將公布的 9 月非農就業報告，這將是Fed 評估下一步利率政策的重要依據。
paras_en: The market is focused on the U.S. non‑farm payroll data that will be released later today. Taipei’s foreign‑exchange market turned relatively quiet, and the New Taiwan dollar slipped below the 31.9 per USD mark during the session. Foreign investors were active on both sides, but overall Asian currencies were on the rise. In the final minutes, after central‑bank intervention, the TWD closed at 31.83 per USD, a modest gain of 0.12 and the third consecutive rise. The total turnover in the Taipei and Yuan‑Tai foreign‑exchange market shrank to $2.191 billion.

Taipei’s stock and FX market had only four trading days this week. Because the U.S.–Iran conflict showed no sign of easing, the dollar remained relatively strong, and the TWD/USD pair depreciated a cumulative 5 ticks, or 0.16%, turning the weekly chart back into the red.

Taiwan’s heavyweight electronic stocks gave little guidance today, with the early session showing a choppy range. However, small‑ and mid‑cap stocks in passive components, optical communications, PCBs and silicon wafers took the lead, lifting the index to a high of 48,491.62 points—just 110 points shy of the intraday record of 48,601.53. The market closed up 122.25 points at 48,475.74, still posting a new closing high, with a turnover of NT$898.174 billion. Foreign investors were net buyers of NT$2.622 billion of Taiwan equities today.

The New Taiwan dollar opened at 31.87 per USD and fell nearly 0.10 during the session, reaching a low of 31.935. To prevent the TWD from drifting too far from the major Asian currencies, the central bank stepped in, turning the depreciation into appreciation and ending the day at 31.83.

Looking at the performance of major currencies today, central‑bank data show the Korean won surged 1.13%, making it the strongest Asian currency of the day. The Japanese yen also rose sharply by 0.51%, the Star coin appreciated 0.15%, the New Taiwan dollar edged up 0.04%, while the Chinese renminbi was closed for the National Day holiday.

Wednesday’s data showed that August U.S. inflation rose less than expected and July’s figures were revised lower, easing market expectations of a Fed rate hike this month. Attention now shifts to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics’ upcoming September non‑farm payroll report, which will be a key reference for the Fed’s next interest‑rate decision.

items.title: 華邦電4工人傳工安意外 公司：已送醫治療、將配合後續調查
items.title_en: WPG Holdings 4 Workers Involved in Safety Accident: Company Says They Have Been Hospitalized and Will Cooperate with Follow-up Investigation
paras: 記憶體廠華邦電(2344-TW)現正積極擴充產能，今(2)日11時於南科高雄路竹廠傳出重大工安意外，傳出共有4名工人在進行化學管路施工時，不慎遭強酸噴濺，造成多處灼傷，公司表示，事件發生後公司已立即啟動應變機制，傷者已送醫治療，目前生命徵象均穩定，事件發生詳細原因仍在調查中，公司將全力協助傷者並配合後續調查。
據了解，華邦電的外包商人員在廠區內進行化學管路施工，遭到俗稱「化骨水」的氫氟酸與硝酸混合化學廢液噴濺，造成4名工人身體多處灼傷，分別緊急送往義大醫院及高雄榮總搶救。4名傷者中有3名外包商員工、1名華邦電員工，當中年紀最小僅22歲。
4名傷者在現場接受初步處置後，由救護人員協助送醫進一步檢查與治療，當時均保持清醒，暫無生命危險，至於實際傷勢程度及後續治療情況，仍待醫療院所進一步評估。事故發生後，高雄市勞工檢查相關單位等主管機關已介入調查，將釐清事故發生的確切原因，以及當時外包廠商施工程序、危害性化學物質管理、現場安全防護措施及相關作業是否符合規定。
paras_en: Memory chip maker WPG Holdings (2344‑TW) is actively expanding capacity. At 11:00 a.m. today, a major safety incident occurred at its Kaohsiung Lu‑Chu plant in the Southern Taiwan Science Park. Four workers were injured when strong acid was accidentally sprayed during chemical piping work, causing multiple burns. The company said it immediately activated its emergency response, the injured were taken to hospital for treatment and their vital signs are stable. The exact cause is still under investigation, and the company will fully assist the victims and cooperate with subsequent inquiries.

According to reports, subcontractor personnel were performing chemical piping work on site when a mixture of hydrofluoric acid—commonly called “bone‑dissolving water”—and nitric acid waste spray hit them, causing burns on several parts of the bodies of four workers. They were rushed to E‑Da Hospital and Kaohsiung Veterans General Hospital. Among the four injured, three are subcontractor employees and one is a WPG employee, the youngest being only 22 years old.

After receiving initial on‑site treatment, the four workers were escorted by paramedics to hospitals for further examination and care. They were all conscious at the time and faced no immediate life‑threatening condition; the severity of their injuries and subsequent treatment will be assessed by medical staff. Following the accident, labor inspection authorities in Kaohsiung and other regulatory bodies have launched an investigation to determine the precise cause, examine the subcontractor’s work procedures, hazardous chemical management, on‑site safety measures, and whether operations complied with regulations.

items.title: 黃仁勳Q3巨星般高調曝光 助攻輝達單季狂飆17% 狠甩標普500
items.title_en: Jensen Huang’s Star‑Power Fuels Nvidia’s Q3 Surge, Outpacing the S&P 500 by 17%
paras: 隨著 2026 年第三季劃下句點，人工智慧龍頭輝達再度以傲人成績驚豔全球資本市場。輝達執行長黃仁勳 (Jensen Huang) 在過去三個月內頻繁曝光，成功轉化為投資人的實質回報。
黃仁勳過去三個月身穿招牌黑色皮衣的身影遍及各大科技峰會、財報會議、媒體專訪，甚至與美國總統川普 (President Trump) 共進餐敘，更豪砸 129 億美元收購知名 AI 平台 Hugging Face。
這股強大的個人魅力與戰略宣示，成功轉化為投資人的實質回報，輝達 (NVDA-US)第三季股價狂飆 17%，遠超標普 500 指數同期 4.3% 的漲幅，今年以來累計漲幅已達 23%。
川普支持 AI 自律 輝達迎來政策利多
黃仁勳週二 (29 日) 出席白宮 AI 午餐會，與科技業領袖討論產業發展及安全監管。與會人士對監管方向立場不一，Anthropic 執行長阿莫戴 (Dario Amodei) 主張加強限制，黃仁勳則支持由業界自律。
川普會後表示，「自我監管非常重要」，並稱讚站在身旁的黃仁勳是「帥氣的傢伙」。
市場分析，川普對產業自律的支持，代表黃仁勳在 AI 監管辯論中取得重要進展，可望有利於輝達長期股價表現。
與會執行長也簽署聲明，承諾維護 AI 技術安全，並遵循自願性原則，包括透過內部控制監督模型開發，以及接受外部模型審查。
對輝達而言，更關鍵的是，會議似乎未提及限制資料中心建設，或限制用於訓練 AI 模型的晶片供應。這項會議結果，有利於輝達持續拓展算力業務。
129 億美元收購 Hugging Face 擴大開發者布局
輝達斥資 129 億美元收購 AI 開發平台 Hugging Face，則是擴大客戶與開發者生態系的重要布局。除了服務大型 AI 公司，輝達也希望讓更多開發者運用其硬體，打造開放模型與各類專業應用。
Rational Equity Armor Fund 投資組合經理 Joe Tigay 分析，若 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 成為主導市場的平台，輝達可以向它們出售算力；但若未來市場由數千個開放模型及專業應用共同組成，Hugging Face 也能讓輝達參與其中。這項策略有助於輝達長期分散客戶來源。
破紀錄 1,500 億美元庫藏股計畫 展現極致財務自信
輝達的強勁表現不僅源於黃仁勳的明星氣場，更有極其紮實的基本面作後盾。
輝達於本週一震撼宣布一項高達 1,500 億美元的股票回購計畫，創下全球歷史上最大規模紀錄，使其總庫藏股授權額度一舉推升至 2,300 億美元，向市場宣告公司對未來現金流與價值的強烈信心。
此外，黃仁勳日前出席高盛全球科技峰會 (Goldman Sachs Communacopia & Tech Conference) 時重申，預計至 2030 年，全球 AI 市場規模將達到 3 兆至 4 兆美元。
而在 8 月的最新財報會議上，黃仁勳更給出令市場驚嘆的前瞻指引：預計 2028 財年營收成長率將高達 70%，遠超華爾街分析師原本預期的 45%。
黃仁勳指出，若非全球記憶體晶片短缺限制了產能，輝達的營收成長率甚至有機會突破 100%。
同業高管盛讚：前所未見的 AI 時代領航者
輝達在 AI 晶片領域的絕對霸主地位，也獲得科技巨頭的高度認同。
雲端巨擘 Salesforce (CRM-US) 執行長馬克·貝尼奧夫 (Marc Benioff) 在本月的 Dreamforce 大會上與黃仁勳同台，並於接受採訪時盛讚：「黃仁勳擁有極少數能打造超大規模資料中心的頂級客戶……輝達最卓越之處，在於他們掌握了這個時代最關鍵的產品，這種競爭優勢在科技史上前所未見。」
隨著生成式 AI 需求持續爆發，輝達憑藉頂尖的硬體實力與戰略佈局，持續鞏固其作為全球 AI 革命核心引擎的無可撼動地位。
從大型資料中心客戶，到 Hugging Face 所連結的開發者與開放模型社群，輝達正持續擴大算力需求來源。隨著白宮支持 AI 產業自律，市場也將關注其產品需求、供應能力與營收展望，能否持續支撐股價表現。
paras_en: As the third quarter of 2026 draws to a close, AI leader Nvidia once again dazzles global capital markets with stellar results. CEO Jensen Huang has been in the spotlight constantly over the past three months, turning that visibility into tangible returns for investors.

In the past three months Huang, clad in his signature black leather jacket, has appeared at major tech summits, earnings briefings and media interviews, even dining with President Trump and splurging $12.9 billion to acquire the well‑known AI platform Hugging Face.

That potent mix of personal charisma and strategic signaling has translated into real investor gains: Nvidia (NVDA‑US) stock jumped 17% in Q3, far outpacing the S&P 500’s 4.3% gain for the same period, and up 23% year‑to‑date so far.
Trump backs AI self‑regulation, giving Nvidia a policy tailwind

On Tuesday the 29th, Huang attended a White House AI lunch, discussing industry development and safety regulation with tech leaders. Participants were split on regulatory stance, with Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei urging tighter limits while Huang advocated industry self‑governance.
After the meeting, Trump said “self‑regulation is very important” and praised the man beside him as a “handsome guy.”
Analysts note that Trump’s endorsement of industry self‑regulation marks a significant win for Huang in the AI‑regulation debate and could benefit Nvidia’s long‑term share performance.
The attending CEOs also signed a pledge to safeguard AI safety and follow voluntary principles, including internal controls over model development and external model audits.

For Nvidia, the key takeaway is that the meeting did not raise any caps on data‑center construction or on chips used to train AI models, a result that favours Nvidia’s continued expansion of its compute business.
$12.9 billion acquisition of Hugging Face expands developer footprint

Nvidia’s $12.9 billion purchase of the AI development platform Hugging Face is a major step in broadening its customer and developer ecosystem. Beyond serving large AI firms, Nvidia hopes to enable more developers to use its hardware to build open models and a variety of specialised applications.

Rational Equity Armor Fund portfolio manager Joe Tigay explains that if OpenAI and Anthropic dominate the market, Nvidia can sell them compute power; but if the future market consists of thousands of open models and niche applications, Hugging Face will let Nvidia participate in that ecosystem, diversifying its customer base over the long term.
Record‑breaking $150 billion share‑repurchase plan showcases extreme financial confidence
Nvidia’s impressive performance stems not only from Huang’s star power but also from rock‑solid fundamentals.

Nvidia shocked the market on Monday by announcing a $150 billion stock buyback, the largest ever in history, raising its total authorised treasury‑stock limit to $230 billion and signalling strong confidence in future cash flow and valuation.
At the Goldman Sachs Communacopia & Tech Conference, Huang reiterated his forecast that the global AI market will reach $3‑4 trillion by 2030.
In the August earnings call, Huang gave a bold forward‑looking guide: fiscal‑year‑2028 revenue growth is expected to hit 70%, far above Wall Street’s 45% consensus.
Huang added that absent the global memory‑chip shortage that now limits capacity, Nvidia’s revenue growth could even break the 100% mark.
Peers laud him as an unprecedented AI‑era trailblazer
Nvidia’s undisputed dominance in AI chips has earned high praise from other tech giants.

Salesforce (CRM‑US) CEO Marc Benioff shared the stage with Huang at this month’s Dreamforce conference and, in an interview, praised him: “Huang is one of the few who can build ultra‑large‑scale data centres for top‑tier customers… Nvidia’s greatest strength is that it controls the most critical product of this era; that competitive edge is unprecedented in tech history.”
With generative‑AI demand exploding, Nvidia’s top‑tier hardware and strategic positioning continue to cement its unshakable role as the core engine of the global AI revolution.

From massive data‑center customers to the developer and open‑model community linked through Hugging Face, Nvidia is constantly expanding sources of compute demand. With the White House backing AI industry self‑regulation, the market will watch product demand, supply capacity and revenue outlook to see if they can sustain the stock’s performance.

items.title: 川普憂弱勢日元衝擊美貿易 高市：日元低估本身就是問題
items.title_en: Trump Worried Weak Yen Threatens US Trade; Kōchi: Yen Undervaluation Is a Problem in Itself
paras: 日本首相高市早苗周四(1日)透露，她上個月在紐約與美國總統川普會談時，被告知日元疲弱正導致美國貿易面臨困境。
高市接受日本電視台(NTV)獨家專訪，被問到美日雙方是否就如何處理日元疲弱問題取得一致時，她說：「在日美領袖會談中，對方提到美國貿易因日元疲弱而面臨困難，我則回應，按照一般原則，日元被低估本身就是一個問題。」
高市並透露與財務大臣片山皐月對談時獲悉，美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)曾表示，他理解日本政府的經濟政策，也沒有就政策方向提出任何要求。
她在周四晚間播出的專訪中說：「我們在繼續負責任且積極的財政政策下，追求強健經濟與永續財政的想法並沒有改變。」
川普政府近來罕見頻頻表達對日元疲弱的關切。貝森特多次暗示，日本銀行(央行，BOJ)應升息，以協助日元找到適當價位。他在德州一所大學演講時曾說，他對日本政策制定者接下來的行動「相當有把握」，甚至向投機客嗆聲「我是莊家」，要求他們押注日元貶值、與他對作。
先前日元兌美元貶至164附近之後，日美當局曾共同介入外匯市場，是雙方美日28年來首次聯手支撐日元。川普當時形容，這項干預是友誼的象徵。
日本官員通常會淡化美方言論對日本政策制定方面的影響。高市在專訪中避免對外匯市場做出具體評論，轉而談及她對經濟振興的願景，強調這將有助於支撐日元。
她說：「我們希望透過大膽投資風險管理與成長領域，提高日本潛在經濟成長率並強化供應能力，以實現強健經濟。我相信，提高日本經濟的競爭力，最終將有助於建立對日元的信心。」
paras_en: Japanese Prime Minister Naoto Kōchi said on Thursday (the 1st) that during her meeting with US President Donald Trump in New York last month, she was told that a weak yen is causing difficulties for US trade.

In an exclusive interview with Japan's NTV, when asked whether the US and Japan had reached a consensus on how to handle the weak yen, she said: “During the US‑Japan leaders’ talks, the US side mentioned that American trade is facing challenges because of the weak yen. I responded that, as a general principle, an undervalued yen is itself a problem.”

Kōchi also revealed that in a conversation with Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama she learned that US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent had said he understands Japan’s economic policy and has not made any demands regarding its direction.
In the interview aired Thursday evening she said: “Our commitment to responsible and proactive fiscal policy, and our pursuit of a strong economy and sustainable finances, remains unchanged.”

The Trump administration has lately expressed unusually frequent concern over the weak yen. Bessent has repeatedly hinted that the Bank of Japan should raise rates to help the yen find an appropriate level. Speaking at a Texas university, he said he is “quite confident” about the next steps Japanese policymakers will take and even taunted speculators, saying “I’m the house” and urging them to bet on yen depreciation in line with his view.

After the yen fell to around 164 per dollar, US and Japanese authorities jointly intervened in the foreign‑exchange market – the first US‑Japan coordinated support for the yen in 28 years. Trump at the time described the intervention as a symbol of friendship.

Japanese officials usually downplay the impact of US statements on Japan’s policy‑making. In the interview Kōchi avoided specific comments on the FX market, instead discussing her vision for economic revitalisation and stressing that it would help support the yen.

She said: “We aim to boost Japan’s potential growth rate and strengthen supply capacity through bold investment, risk management and growth‑sector focus, to achieve a robust economy. I believe that enhancing Japan’s competitiveness will ultimately help build confidence in the yen.”

items.title: 美債反彈難掩緊縮背景！華爾街警告：今晚非農就業數據恐得「崩盤」　才能扭轉升息定價
items.title_en: U.S. Treasury Rebound Can’t Mask Tightening Backdrop! Wall Street Warns Tonight’s Nonfarm Payrolls Could ‘Collapse’ to Reverse Rate‑Hike Pricing
paras: 經歷連續數週拋售後，美債市場終於出現明顯反彈，10年期美債殖利率從24年高點回落，但市場並未因此改變對後續升息的基本判斷，只將注意力轉向今晚公佈的9月非農就業報告。若就業僅溫和降溫，債市恐很難繼續反彈，只有明顯弱於預期的就業和薪資數據，才可能迫使投資者大舉撤回升息押注。
美債周四(1日)結束先前的猛烈拋售，兩年期美債殖利率一度跌約10個基點至4.8%以下，10年期也從5.34%左右的2002年來最高水準回落，在歐洲股市交易盤前於5.25%附近波動。
10年期美債殖利率在今年Q3創下本世紀以來最大季度升幅祭陸，9月單月上漲超過50個基點，為2022年9月以來最大月度升幅；規模約32兆美元的美債市場正經歷近年來少見的劇烈調整。30年期殖利率同期升至5.638%，創2002年6月來新高。
美國債市反彈的原因並非基本面轉向，部分買盤來自歐洲債市風險上升帶來的避險需求，因法國10年債殖利率一度上漲約10個基點，英國30年期突破6%，為1998年3月來首見。
與此同時，聯準會(Fed)官員近期釋出「沒有必要急於在10月繼續升息」的訊號。Fed副主席威廉斯周四說，未來政策調整需要結合數據趨勢、經濟前景和風險變化進行判斷，形成結論「可能需要更多時間」。他並指出，裁員人數維持低位、職缺數量整體略微回升，勞動市場狀況已穩定下來。
目前，升息預期被後移，而非被取消。交易員預估Fed本月升息1碼機率約25%，一週前一度接近70%，但12月升息仍已被市場充分定價。
雖然利率期貨市場數據略微削減升息幅度，仍預估到明年7月之前，Fed至少還會累積升息75個基點。Fed上月已將聯邦基金利率目標區間調高1碼至3.75%—4%，點陣圖也顯示18名官員中有16人預估今年內至少再升息一次，年底政策利率預測中位數升至4.1%。
本次非農面臨一個不對稱的門檻。市場普遍預期9月非農就業人數增加約9萬人；《路透社》調查預測區間為3.5萬至18萬人，《CNBC》稱8.4萬人，低於8月16.2萬人，失業率預計維持在4.1%，為一年來最低水準。
T. Rowe Price投等債券主管Steve Boothe認為，要讓就業數據真正推動美債繼續上漲，門檻已經相當高，光是低於市場預期仍不夠，新增就業人數恐需接近於零，甚至轉負，且薪資數據也明顯弱於預期，才能改變當前的利率交易。原因在於，Fed目前面對的核心衝突仍是通膨。
周三(9月30日)公布的美國通膨數據略低於預期，美債聞訊曾迅速走漲，但隨後幾乎完全回吐漲幅，長期殖利率重新逼近數十年高點，這顯示投資人目前的部位明顯偏向殖利率持續上升，較溫和的利多數據已經難以改變趨勢。
BMO Capital Markets美國利率策略主管Ian Lyngen認為，如果9月非農數據意外顯示勞動市場開始出現壓力，美債上漲幅度可能反而非常明顯，因投資人屆時需要集中平掉部分押注利率上升的部位，這也形成了目前債市的不對稱狀態，也就是符合預期或略強的就業數據，恐繼續維持高利率環境；真正疲弱的數據，則可能觸發規模更大的空頭回補。
Federated Hermes固定收益策略師Karen Manna表示，自9月16日Fed升息以來，她對債市的悲觀看法已減弱，因為此前預期中的相當一部分殖利率上行已經兌現，但目前仍無法確認已經見頂。
paras_en: After weeks of continuous selling, the U.S. Treasury market finally showed a clear rebound, with the 10‑year yield pulling back from its 2024 peak, but the market’s fundamental view on further rate hikes remains unchanged, shifting its focus to tonight’s September nonfarm payroll report. If employment only cools modestly, the bond market may struggle to keep rising; only a clearly weaker‑than‑expected jobs and wage report could force investors to pull back their rate‑hike bets.

U.S. Treasuries on Thursday (the 1st) ended the earlier aggressive sell‑off, with the two‑year yield briefly dropping about 10 basis points to below 4.8%, and the 10‑year falling from around the 2002‑high of 5.34% to about 5.25% in pre‑market European trading.

The 10‑year yield posted the biggest quarterly gain of this century in Q3, climbing more than 50 basis points in September – the largest monthly rise since September 2022 – as the roughly $32 trillion Treasury market undergoes a rare, sharp correction. The 30‑year yield rose in tandem to 5.638%, a new high since June 2002.

The bond rally is not driven by fundamentals; part of the buying comes from heightened risk in European bonds, prompting safe‑haven demand after France’s 10‑year yield jumped about 10 basis points and the UK’s 30‑year broke 6% for the first time since March 1998.

At the same time, Federal Reserve officials have recently signaled that there is “no need to rush to keep raising rates in October.” Fed Vice‑Chair Williams said on Thursday that future policy moves will depend on data trends, economic outlook and risk changes, concluding that “more time may be needed.” He also noted that layoffs remain low and job openings have edged up slightly, indicating a stabilising labour market.

Rate‑hike expectations have been pushed back, not cancelled. Traders now see about a 25% chance of a one‑point hike this month, down from nearly 70% a week ago, while a December hike is already fully priced in by the market.

Even though rate‑future data have trimmed the expected hike size a bit, they still project that the Fed will add at least 75 basis points of hikes by July next year. The Fed last month lifted the federal‑funds target range by one point to 3.75%‑4.00%, and the dot‑plot shows 16 of 18 officials expect at least one more hike this year, with the median end‑year policy rate now at 4.1%.

The upcoming payroll report faces an asymmetric threshold. The market broadly expects September nonfarm employment to rise by about 90,000 jobs; Reuters polls a range of 35,000‑180,000, CNBC cites 84,000 – down from August’s 162,000 – and the unemployment rate is projected to hold at 4.1%, a one‑year low.

Steve Boothe, head of fixed‑income at T. Rowe Price, says the bar for jobs data to actually push Treasuries higher is already very high – merely missing forecasts won’t be enough. New jobs may need to be near zero or even negative, and wages must be clearly weaker than expected, to shift the current rate‑trade. The underlying conflict for the Fed remains inflation.

U.S. inflation data released on Wednesday (Sept. 30) came in slightly below expectations, prompting a brief rally in Treasuries that was almost entirely erased afterward, with long‑term yields again edging toward multi‑decade highs. This shows investors are now positioned for continued yield rises, and modestly positive data can no longer change the trend.

Ian Lyngen, head of U.S. rates strategy at BMO Capital Markets, warns that if September’s payrolls unexpectedly show labour‑market stress, Treasury gains could be pronounced, as investors would need to unwind part of their rate‑rise bets. This creates the current bond‑market asymmetry: employment data that meets or slightly exceeds expectations may keep rates high, while truly weak data could trigger a larger short‑covering rally.

Karen Manna, fixed‑income strategist at Federated Hermes, says her bearish outlook on bonds has softened since the Fed’s September 16 rate hike, as much of the anticipated yield rise has already materialised, though she still cannot confirm that yields have peaked.

paras: 美國勞動市場能否維持穩定，今晚將迎來最新檢驗。美國勞工統計局 (BLS) 將於美東時間週五 (2 日) 上午 8 時 30 分、台北時間晚間 8 時 30 分公布 9 月非農就業報告。這份備受市場關注的數據，也將成為聯準會 (Fed) 評估下一步利率政策的重要依據。
根據道瓊調查的市場共識，經濟學家預估，9 月非農就業人數將新增 8.4 萬人，失業率則維持在 4.1%。
儘管新增就業人數較 2025 年以前放緩，但失業率仍處於聯準會官員認定的「充分就業」範圍。此前，8 月非農就業新增 16.2 萬人，遠優於預期，前幾個月數據也獲上修，為市場信心提供支撐。
聯準會官員：勞動市場趨穩 焦點轉向通膨
隨著勞動市場展現韌性，聯準會官員的政策焦點逐漸轉向居高不下的通膨。
聯準會副主席傑佛遜 (Philip Jefferson) 週四在公開演說中指出：「多項數據顯示，勞動市場狀況已趨於穩定。雖然新增就業人數略有波動，但近幾個月的就業成長已擴及更多產業，令人鼓舞。裁員率持續偏低，職缺總數也略有回升。」
紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯 (John Williams) 本週稍早也強調，就業市場維持穩健，甚至略有改善，聯準會在 9 月調整利率後，並不急於再次採取行動。
這番談話帶動市場調整預期，利率期貨市場大幅下修聯準會在 10 月 27 日至 28 日政策會議上升息的機率，普遍認為 12 月採取行動的可能性更高。
「低聘僱、低裁員」格局延續?
回顧 2026 年，美國每月就業數據起伏不定，2 月就業人數減少 15.6 萬人，3 月則大增 21.4 萬人，今年以來平均每月新增就業約 8 萬人。
薪資方面，市場預估，9 月平均時薪年增率將放緩至 3.1%，低於年初約 4% 的水準。聯準會官員多次強調，目前薪資成長並非推升通膨的主要因素，薪資與物價相互推升的風險偏低，讓聯準會有空間耐心觀察數據。
安聯貿易 (Allianz Trade) 資深經濟學家 Dan North 表示：「目前職缺減少，企業聘僱速度也在放緩，數據與訪談回饋都顯示，找工作的難度增加，但失業率始終維持在歷史低點附近，『穩定』是形容當前勞動市場最貼切的詞。」
儘管官方數據顯示勞動市場維持平穩，勞工的實際感受卻未必如此。
求職網站 Glassdoor 最新調查顯示，9 月員工信心指數降至歷史新低，也是今年第 3 次改寫新低紀錄。Glassdoor 首席經濟學家 Daniel Zhao 指出，員工持續擔憂工作保障、經濟不確定性與通膨，人工智慧 (AI) 可能取代工作的疑慮，也加重職場焦慮。
不過，企業端數據顯示，目前尚未出現大規模裁員。美國上週首次申請失業救濟金人數略降至 19.7 萬人；就業顧問機構 Challenger, Gray & Christmas 週四公布的報告也顯示，9 月企業宣布的裁員人數較 8 月減少 18%，較去年同期下降 20%。
今晚公布的非農就業報告，將進一步顯示美國勞動市場能否延續「聘僱放緩、裁員偏低」的平衡，也將牽動市場對聯準會後續利率政策的判斷。
paras_en: The stability of the U.S. labor market will be tested tonight. The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) will release the September nonfarm payroll report at 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time on Friday (the 2nd), which is 8:30 p.m. Taipei time. This market‑watched data will also serve as a key input for the Federal Reserve in assessing its next rate‑policy move.
According to the market consensus surveyed by Dow Jones, economists expect September nonfarm payrolls to increase by 84,000 jobs, with the unemployment rate holding at 4.1%.

Although the pace of job gains has slowed compared with pre‑2025 levels, the unemployment rate remains within the Fed officials’ definition of “full employment.” In August, payrolls added 162,000 jobs, well above expectations, and earlier months’ figures were revised upward, bolstering market confidence.
Fed officials: Labor market stabilizing, focus shifting to inflation
As the labor market shows resilience, Fed officials are gradually turning their policy focus toward persistently high inflation.

Fed Vice Chair Philip Jefferson said on Thursday in a public speech, “Multiple data points show that labor‑market conditions have become more stable. While job gains have fluctuated slightly, employment growth in recent months has spread to more industries, which is encouraging. The layoff rate remains low, and the total number of job openings has edged up.”

New York Fed President John Williams also emphasized earlier this week that the employment market remains solid, even modestly improving, and the Fed is not in a hurry to act again after its September rate adjustment.

These comments prompted the market to revise expectations sharply, with rate‑futures pricing a much lower probability of a hike at the Fed’s Oct. 27‑28 policy meeting and a higher likelihood of action in December.
Will the “low hiring, low layoffs” pattern persist?

Looking back at 2026, U.S. monthly employment data have been volatile: February saw a loss of 156,000 jobs, March added a surge of 214,000, and the average monthly gain so far this year has been about 80,000 jobs.

On wages, the market expects September’s average hourly earnings growth to slow to an annualized 3.1%, down from roughly 4% at the start of the year. Fed officials have repeatedly stressed that current wage growth is not the main driver of inflation, and the risk of wages and prices feeding each other is low, giving the Fed room to observe the data patiently.

Allianz Trade senior economist Dan North said, “Job openings are declining and firms are hiring more slowly; both the data and interview feedback show that job‑search difficulty is rising, yet the unemployment rate stays near historic lows. ‘Stability’ is the most apt description of today’s labor market.”
Even though official data show a steady labor market, workers’ real‑world experiences may not match that picture.

A latest Glassdoor survey shows the September employee confidence index fell to a historic low, the third such record low this year. Glassdoor chief economist Daniel Zhao noted that employees remain worried about job security, economic uncertainty and inflation, and fears that AI could replace jobs are adding to workplace anxiety.

Nevertheless, corporate data indicate no large‑scale layoffs yet. First‑time unemployment claims in the U.S. slipped slightly to 197,000 last week; a report from Challenger, Gray & Christmas on Thursday showed that September corporate layoff announcements fell 18% from August and were down 20% year‑over‑year.

The nonfarm payroll report released tonight will further reveal whether the U.S. labor market can maintain the “slowing hiring, low layoffs” balance and will influence market judgments on the Fed’s future rate policy.

items.title: Anthropic到底值多少？矽谷喊2兆美元 華爾街只認1.5兆美元
items.title_en: What Is Anthropic Worth? Silicon Valley Calls $2 Trillion, Wall Street Only Recognizes $1.5 Trillion
paras: Anthropic尚未啟動正式IPO說明會，矽谷與華爾街已對估值出現明顯分歧。
《The Information》報導，部分創投與私募投資人在早期溝通中討論給予約2兆美元估值，兩家大型投資機構卻認為，公開市場較合理的定價應接近1.5兆美元。
Anthropic預計仍需數週才會展開正式上市說明會，原本被視為年內最受矚目的上市案之一，但股市波動已開始影響投資人對大型科技IPO的定價態度。
矽谷押未來，華爾街算風險
2兆與1.5兆美元的落差，反映兩套不同的投資邏輯。Lead Edge Capital公開市場投資組合經理Evan Skorpen表示，創投通常思考的是，公司在最樂觀的情境下能值多少錢，而AI市場確實充滿令人振奮的數據。
公開市場投資人卻不能只看好的一面。Skorpen指出，由於每天都要持有股票，投資人必須更關注哪些事情可能出錯。他將這種差異形容為，矽谷投資人在沙丘路押注未來，華爾街投資人則每天盯著股價衡量風險。
Anthropic已承諾購買至少14.8吉瓦的算力容量，相關協議未來十年的成本可能超過5000億美元。路透本週揭露的IPO招股書草案數據，也再度引發市場對其財務承諾與風險曝險的關注。
AI回報可期 但誰先買單？
聯博中小型成長股首席投資長Samantha Lau表示，現在任何準備上市的公司，都必須合理定價，但她尚未看到這一點。「打開市場的唯一辦法，就是保守一些。」
Anthropic與OpenAI等AI龍頭即使完成IPO，預計仍須持續融資，支應資料中心、晶片與算力支出。
Lau看好AI代理軟體的能力，也認同這些能力可能為基礎設施投資帶來回報，但利率上升推高借貸成本，投資機構需要看到能實現的收益。她提出的關鍵問題是：「在走到最終理想狀態之前，誰來為這件事買單？」
競爭也增添變數。據報導，OpenAI最新模型在企業客戶市場取得進展，並正初步洽談約300億美元的上市前融資。若交易推進，兩家公司可能爭取部分相同的資金來源。
上市市場開始拒絕高價
投資人對估值的謹慎，已影響其他上市案。智慧戒指公司Oura週二突然延後IPO，原定隔天敲定最終發行價；知情人士指出，投資人認為其估值要價過高。
軟銀旗下SB Energy也尚未啟動IPO行銷。該公司正為OpenAI在俄亥俄州興建大型設施，投行討論的估值約600億美元，但部分IPO投資人難以接受，也有人擔憂其收入過度依賴OpenAI。
準備上市的Nscale與資料中心開發商Switch，同樣面臨投資人對高負債及後續融資需求的疑慮。一名資深IPO投資人表示，這些情況提醒投行與私募股權業者：「我們不是價格接受者。」
私募熱度未退 泡沫警訊浮現
相較之下，私募市場仍願意以高價投資AI。消費助理Instinct的開發公司本週宣布，成立僅一年便以100億美元估值募得10億美元，投資人包括紅杉資本、Benchmark與Coatue。
但創投圈也開始警覺。紅杉資本負責人之一Pat Grady指出，創投普遍認為AI能力快速提升，已觸及仍具爭議的「通用人工智慧」門檻，然而「估值完全瘋狂」。
他表示，部分新創完成一輪融資後，很快又以大幅提高的估值進行下一輪融資，是泡沫的典型標誌。
大型IPO仍有資金支撐
市場仍存在支撐因素。SpaceX今年6月透過史上最大IPO募得近860億美元，上市後股價上漲約10%，估值約2兆美元，表現優於大盤，也為早期投資人帶來可再投入AI的資金。
部分大型共同基金先前已以較低價格持有Anthropic股份，可能因此對IPO定價有較高容忍度。輝達、Alphabet、亞馬遜與現有投資人，也可能繼續提供資金。
Vista Equity Partners股票資本市場策略負責人Ashley MacNeill表示，私募市場的高估值似乎尚未完全傳導至公開市場，而超大型IPO接連出現，讓這道落差格外明顯。
paras_en: Anthropic has not yet launched a formal IPO roadshow, and Silicon Valley and Wall Street already show a clear split on its valuation.

The Information reported that some venture capital and private‑equity investors discussed a pre‑money valuation of $2 trillion in early talks, while two large investment firms argued that a more realistic pricing in the public market should be close to $1.5 trillion.

Anthropic expects it will still be several weeks before it begins a formal listing presentation. It was originally seen as one of the most watched IPOs of the year, but market volatility has already begun to affect investors' pricing attitudes toward large‑tech IPOs.
Silicon Valley bets on the future, Wall Street calculates risk

The $2 trillion versus $1.5 trillion gap reflects two different investment logics. Lead Edge Capital public‑market portfolio manager Evan Skorpen said venture capitalists usually think about how much a company could be worth in the most optimistic scenario, and the AI market indeed is full of exciting data.

Public‑market investors, however, cannot look only at the upside. Skorpen noted that because they hold the stock daily, investors must pay more attention to what could go wrong. He described the difference as Silicon Valley investors betting on the future on Dune Road, while Wall Street investors watch the stock price every day to gauge risk.

Anthropic has pledged to purchase at least 14.8 GW of compute capacity, and the related agreements could cost over $500 billion over the next ten years. Reuters this week disclosed draft IPO prospectus data that again sparked market focus on its financial commitments and risk exposure.
AI returns look promising, but who will foot the bill first?

Liu Bo’s chief investment officer for small‑ and mid‑cap growth stocks Samantha Lau said that any company preparing to go public now must be priced reasonably, and she has not seen that yet. “The only way to open the market is to be more conservative,” she said.
Even if Anthropic and AI leaders like OpenAI complete IPOs, they are expected to continue raising capital to fund data‑center, chip and compute spending.

Lau is bullish on AI agent software capabilities and agrees that these capabilities could generate returns for infrastructure investors, but rising interest rates are pushing up borrowing costs, and investment firms need to see realizable returns. She posed the key question: “Before reaching the ideal end state, who will pay for this?”

Competition adds another variable. Reports say OpenAI’s latest model is gaining traction in the enterprise market and is in early talks for roughly $30 billion of pre‑IPO financing. If the deal moves forward, the two companies could compete for some of the same capital sources.
The listing market is beginning to reject high prices

Investor caution on valuations has already affected other IPOs. Smart‑ring maker Oura abruptly postponed its IPO on Tuesday, which had been set to finalize the final issue price the next day; insiders said investors thought its valuation was too high.

SoftBank’s SB Energy has also not started IPO marketing. The company is building a large facility for OpenAI in Ohio, and bankers are discussing a valuation of about $60 billion, but some IPO investors find it hard to accept, and others worry its revenue is overly dependent on OpenAI.

Companies preparing to list such as Nscale and data‑center developer Switch face investor concerns about high debt and subsequent financing needs. A senior IPO investor said these situations remind banks and private‑equity firms: “We are not price takers.”
Private‑equity heat has not cooled, bubble warnings are emerging

By contrast, the private‑equity market is still willing to invest in AI at high prices. The developer of consumer assistant Instinct announced this week that, just one year after its founding, it raised $1 billion at a $10 billion valuation, with investors including Sequoia Capital, Benchmark and Coatue.

But venture‑capital circles are also becoming wary. One of Sequoia’s partners, Pat Grady, noted that VCs generally believe AI capabilities are improving rapidly and have reached the still‑controversial “general artificial intelligence” threshold, yet “the valuations are completely insane.”
He said that some startups, after closing one financing round, quickly raise the next round at a dramatically higher valuation—a classic sign of a bubble.
Large IPOs still have funding support

There are still supporting factors in the market. In June this year SpaceX raised nearly $86 billion in the largest IPO ever, and after listing its stock rose about 10%, valuing the company at roughly $2 trillion, outperforming the broader market and providing early investors with capital that can be redeployed into AI.

Some large mutual funds already hold Anthropic shares at lower prices, which may give them higher tolerance for IPO pricing. Nvidia, Alphabet, Amazon and existing investors could also continue to provide capital.

Ashley MacNeill, head of stock‑market strategy at Vista Equity Partners, said the high private‑equity valuations have not yet fully filtered into the public market, and the string of mega‑IPOs makes the gap especially stark.

items.title: Palantir攜手Armada擴大主權AI布局作業系統導入Galleon數據中心
items.title_en: Palantir Teams Up with Armada to Expand Sovereign AI Footprint, Deploying OS to Galleon Data Center
paras: 2026年10月02日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ Palantir Technologies(PLTR-US)與邊緣基礎設施業者Armada宣布擴大合作，將Palantir主權AI作業系統整合至Armada旗下Galleon數據中心，加快主權AI基礎設施部署，也讓AI運算進一步從傳統大型數據中心延伸至可在不同環境部署的邊緣基礎設施。
雙方合作重點在於結合Palantir的AI軟體平台與Armada的Galleon數據中心，讓政府及企業能在自主掌控的基礎設施中運行AI模型與應用。對國防、政府及高度監管產業而言，除了運算效能，資料存放位置、系統控制權與資訊安全也逐漸成為導入AI時的重要考量。
Armada的Galleon採模組化設計，可將高效能運算設備部署至傳統大型數據中心以外的環境。雙方先前公布的部署方案，包括搭載輝達NVIDIA(NVDA-US) B300 GPU的模組化數據中心，每個單元配置32顆B300 GPU，使AI推論與高效能運算能力可以更接近資料產生端。
Palantir今年也持續擴大主權AI布局。2026年3月，Palantir與NVIDIA共同發布主權AI作業系統參考架構，涵蓋AI基礎設施、運算硬體與應用部署。此次再將相關軟體能力導入Armada Galleon，代表主權AI架構正從參考設計進一步走向實際基礎設施部署。

paras_en: October 2, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Palantir Technologies (PLTR-US) and edge‑infrastructure provider Armada announced an expanded partnership to integrate Palantir’s sovereign AI operating system into Armada’s Galleon data center, accelerating the deployment of sovereign AI infrastructure and extending AI computing from traditional large‑scale data centers to edge facilities that can be deployed in diverse environments.

The collaboration focuses on combining Palantir’s AI software platform with Armada’s Galleon data center so that governments and enterprises can run AI models and applications on infrastructure they control. For defense, government and highly regulated sectors, data location, system control and information security are becoming as important as compute performance when adopting AI.

Armada’s Galleon uses a modular design that allows high‑performance compute equipment to be placed outside conventional large data centers. The previously announced deployment plan includes modular data‑center units equipped with NVIDIA (NVDA-US) B300 GPUs, each unit housing 32 B300 GPUs, bringing AI inference and high‑performance compute capabilities closer to the data source.

Palantir has continued to expand its sovereign AI footprint this year. In March 2026, Palantir and NVIDIA jointly released a reference architecture for a sovereign AI operating system covering AI infrastructure, compute hardware and application deployment. Bringing those software capabilities into Armada’s Galleon now moves the sovereign AI architecture from a reference design toward actual infrastructure deployment.
