items.title: 美《陽光保護法案》參院卡關 川普重申必須推動永久夏令時間
items.title_en: U.S. Sunshine Protection Act Stalled in Senate, Trump Reiterates Need for Permanent Daylight Saving Time
paras: 隨著美國日光節約時間(夏令時間)即將於11月1日結束，旨在取消每年兩次調整時鐘的《陽光保護法案》(Sunshine Protection Act)目前仍卡在參議院。由於國會參議院因期中選舉休會，預計要到11月上旬才復會，意味著美國民眾今年11月仍需按慣例將時鐘調慢1小時，恢復標準時間。
這項推動永久夏令時間的法案，在眾議院於7月14日以308票贊成、117票反對通過該法案，並獲得跨黨派大力支持。
美國總統川普對此表達強烈支持，他在社群媒體上強調，一年調整兩次時鐘是「愚蠢、不便且成本高昂的行為」，並指出實施永久夏令時間能減少車禍與犯罪、節省能源，讓家庭在傍晚享有更多日照，呼籲參議院「盡速通過法案」。
然而，法案在參議院面臨極大阻力。參院多數黨領袖John Thune先前即質疑，此法案能否順利取得通過所需之60票門檻，據報導，阿肯色州參議員Tom Cotton也出手擱置了此提案。
此外，業界與專家意見同樣分歧。睡眠與健康研究專家指出，一年兩次調時確實會干擾人體生理時鐘，但主張「永久標準時間」比「永久夏令時間」更能配合人體的自然睡眠節律，對健康更佳。
美國滑雪場營運業者也呼籲參議員否決法案，強調冬季清晨若過於陰暗，將為工作人員帶來安全風險、延誤纜車開放，並損害仰賴冬季旅遊的山區經濟。
在參議院復會後，本屆國會僅剩至12月中下旬的會期，若未能及時完成立法，美國民眾短期內仍須繼續適應一年兩次的換時生活。
paras_en: As the United States’ daylight‑saving time is set to end on November 1, the Sunshine Protection Act, which aims to eliminate the twice‑yearly clock changes, remains stuck in the Senate. Because the Senate is recessed for the midterm elections and is not expected to reconvene until early November, Americans will still have to turn their clocks back one hour in November and return to standard time as usual.
The bill to make daylight‑saving time permanent passed the House on July 14 with 308 votes in favor and 117 against, garnering strong bipartisan support.

President Donald Trump voiced strong backing for the measure, posting on social media that changing clocks twice a year is “stupid, inconvenient, and costly,” and noting that permanent daylight‑saving time would reduce traffic accidents and crime, save energy, and give families more evening daylight, urging the Senate to pass the bill quickly.

However, the proposal faces major resistance in the Senate. Majority leader John Thune has questioned whether the bill can reach the 60‑vote threshold needed for passage, and reports say Arkansas Senator Tom Cotton has also put the measure on hold.

Industry and experts are also divided. Sleep and health researchers acknowledge that the biannual clock changes do disrupt the body’s circadian rhythm, but they argue that “permanent standard time” aligns better with natural sleep cycles and is healthier than permanent daylight‑saving time.

U.S. ski‑resort operators have urged senators to reject the bill, warning that overly dark winter mornings pose safety risks for staff, delay lift openings, and hurt mountain economies that depend on winter tourism.

After the Senate reconvenes, the current Congress will have only until mid‑ to late‑December to act; if legislation is not completed in time, Americans will have to continue adjusting their clocks twice a year in the short term.

items.title: 想換掉鮑爾沒那麼簡單！川普鎖定Fed三理事 最終恐難開鍘
items.title_en: Removing Powell Won't Be Easy! Trump Targets Three Fed Governors, Likely Can't Force Their Removal
paras: 美國總統川普可能正在設法撤換聯準會(Fed)七名理事中的三人，分別是已卸下主席職務的鮑爾(Jerome Powell)、庫克(Lisa Cook)和巴爾(Michael Barr)，但近期法院裁決顯示，川普任何相關行動都將面臨重大的法律障礙。
CNBC報導，Fed監察長周三公布Fed總部大樓翻修案調查報告，表示雖然因為監管疏失導致成本超支10億美元，但是沒有發現足以支持移送給檢察官處理的刑事依據，也沒有涉及行政不當的證據。
川普先前一直拿Fed總部翻修成本超支議題試圖撤換鮑爾的主席職務，但未能如願，鮑爾還在主席任期屆滿後罕見繼續擔任Fed理事。這份報告周三公布後，川普大表不滿，表示「鮑爾是一場災難」，還說鮑爾不該繼續留在Fed理事會。
川普已要求司法部長Todd Blanche審查監察長報告。華盛頓特區聯邦檢察官Jeanine Pirro的發言人也表示，該辦公室正在審查這份報告。
可能遭川普鎖定的另外兩人當中，庫克涉及房貸申請爭議，巴爾則與2023年矽谷銀行(SVB)倒閉事件有關。最高法院已經表示庫克可以在訴訟進行期間留任，而根據矽谷銀行倒閉案的初步調查，巴爾個人未被認定應該負責。
曾任Fed總法律顧問的Scott Alvarez表示，如果政府真的對上述三名理事中的任何一人採取行動，可能反而對川普不利，「他們都有理由提起訴訟並留任。如果他們全都留任，而川普繼續推進，那麼他所做的一切只是在傷害自己的政治議程。」

鮑爾誓言留任

CNBC分析，Fed預定10月28日公布最新利率決策，距離11月3日美國期中選舉只剩短短幾天數日。任何法律攻防可能耗時數月，也可能促使川普鎖定的對象暫緩離開Fed的計畫。就算川普真的進一步採取法律行動、並對Fed制度造成影響，但他迫使Fed推翻近期升息決定的能力似乎有限。
Fed檢察長在這份回溯性的報告中於註腳承認，更好的管理「不一定意味著工程整體成本會更低」。報告中也沒有將成本超支歸咎於鮑爾或任何一名理事，而是描述專案管理、承包，以及Fed理事會治理與監督制度存在缺失。監察長辦公室指出，理事會將相關責任交由員工負責，這符合大型組織處理建設工程時通常採取的做法。
Alvarez表示：「我個人認為，這份翻修報告不足以讓法院以正當理由罷免鮑爾。這份報告在刑事層面還了他的清白，但同時也表示他們沒有發現任何行政失當。」
鮑爾可以繼續擔任聯準會理事至2028年1月。他今年3月表示，自己會留任理事，直到法律威脅「真正且徹底結束，而且具備透明度與最終性」。

庫克、巴爾去留也面臨法律攻防

另一方面，川普在周四刊出的《時代》雜誌專訪中，再次抱怨庫克，他說新任聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)在某種程度上「受到」理事會「控制」，然後說：「我們有Lisa在那裡。」
川普似乎正在權衡下一步如何行動。庫克案案仍由美國聯邦地區法院法官Jia Cobb審理，她要求雙方在11月6日前提交聯合狀況報告，說明訴訟應如何繼續，正好是期中選舉後不久。
巴爾涉及的是2023年矽谷銀行倒閉事件。根據調查公司Starling Advisory Group發布的初步報告，Fed銀行監管人員應該早在銀行倒閉前一年就已知悉相關風險。
這份初步調查並未將責任歸於巴爾個人身上。白宮雖然把這起事件的責任大多歸咎於他，卻沒有進一步要求將他解職，這份報告可能沒有足以讓巴爾面臨罷免的證據。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump may be trying to oust three of the seven Federal Reserve governors—former chair Jerome Powell, Lisa Cook, and Michael Barr—but recent court rulings indicate any such moves would face major legal hurdles.

CNBC reported that the Fed's inspector general released a report on the Fed headquarters renovation on Wednesday, noting that although regulatory lapses caused a $1 billion cost overrun, the report found no criminal basis to refer the matter to prosecutors and no evidence of administrative misconduct.

Trump had previously used the Fed headquarters cost overrun to try to remove Powell as chair, but failed; Powell unusually remained on the Board after his chair term ended. After the report’s release on Wednesday, Trump expressed strong displeasure, calling Powell “a disaster” and saying he should not stay on the Board.

Trump has asked Justice Department head Todd Blanche to review the inspector‑general’s report. A spokesperson for Washington, D.C. U.S. Attorney Jeanine Pirro also said the office is reviewing the report.

Among the other two officials Trump may target, Cook is involved in a mortgage‑application dispute and Barr is linked to the 2023 Silicon Valley Bank collapse. The Supreme Court has allowed Cook to stay on the board while litigation proceeds, and preliminary investigations into the SVB failure have not found Barr personally responsible.

Former Fed general counsel Scott Alvarez warned that if the government moves against any of the three governors, it could backfire on Trump, saying “they have grounds to sue and stay on the board. If they all stay and Trump keeps pushing, everything he does will only hurt his own political agenda.”

Powell vows to stay. CNBC analysis notes the Fed is set to announce its next rate decision on Oct. 28, just days before the Nov. 3 U.S. midterm elections. Any legal battles could take months and may delay any plan to force the targeted governors out. Even if Trump takes further legal action, his ability to force the Fed to reverse recent rate hikes appears limited.

The Fed’s inspector general, in a footnote of the retrospective report, acknowledged that better management “does not necessarily mean lower overall project costs.” The report did not attribute the overrun to Powell or any governor, instead citing shortcomings in project management, contracting, and Board governance. The inspector‑general’s office said the Board assigned responsibility to staff, a common practice in large construction projects.

Alvarez said, “In my view, this renovation report is insufficient to give a court a legitimate reason to remove Powell. It clears him on the criminal front while also stating no administrative misconduct was found.”
Powell can serve as a Fed governor until Jan. 2028. In March he said he would remain on the Board until the legal threat “truly and completely ends, with transparency and finality.”

Cook’s and Barr’s futures also face legal battles. In a Thursday interview with Time magazine, Trump again complained about Cook, saying the new Fed chair Kevin Warsh is, to some extent, “controlled” by the Board, and adding, “We have Lisa there.”

Trump appears to be weighing his next steps. Cook’s case is still before U.S. District Judge Jia Cobb, who has ordered both parties to submit a joint status report by Nov. 6 on how the litigation should proceed—just after the midterms.

Barr’s involvement stems from the 2023 Silicon Valley Bank collapse. According to a preliminary report from Starling Advisory Group, Fed regulators should have known about the risks a year before the bank failed.

The preliminary investigation did not place personal blame on Barr. Although the White House has largely blamed him for the episode, it has not pushed for his removal, and the report may lack sufficient evidence to trigger his ouster.

items.title: 脫歐十年後再一次公投？英國首相柏南拋「重回歐盟」選項
items.title_en: Another Brexit Referendum Ten Years On? UK Prime Minister Burnham Puts 'Re‑joining the EU' on the Table
paras: 英國首相柏南(Andy Burnham)在工黨年度大會及後續採訪中指出，英國脫歐已造成「弊大於利」的後果，並宣布政府將著手評估英國與歐盟未來關係的多種長期選項。柏南更坦言，工黨未來的競選宣言中「有可能」納入重新決定是否加入歐盟的公投選項。
柏南透露，政府預計在11月的英國與歐盟峰會前提出相關評估。他所列出的政策路徑包括維持現狀、借鑑前財相歐斯本(George Osborne)提出的關稅同盟方案、採納自由民主黨主張的單一市場，或是「走到底」完全重新加入歐盟。
柏南強調，雖然當前並非立即推動公投的時機，但英國若不對最大貿易夥伴做出長期定位，將無法突破發展瓶頸。他同時指出，脫歐反而削弱了英國在移民與邊境控管上的合作效率。
倫敦市長汗(Sadiq Khan)對此公開表達支持，引述柏南「希望來自誠實」的說法，痛批脫歐是英國歷史上「災難性的國家自我傷害」。 汗引述倫敦市政府的研究數據指出，脫歐已導致倫敦經濟規模縮減約300億英鎊、全國減少近200萬個工作機會。
他強烈呼籲工黨政府應在本屆國會任期內率先重返關稅同盟與單一市場，並在2029年大選前向選民論述重新加入歐盟的必要性。
「政府效率智庫」(Institute for Government)研究員Jill Rutter分析，柏南的立場與前首相施凱爾(Keir Starmer)過去畫出的紅線有顯著切割，正式將「重返歐盟」議題帶回政治主流。
然而，此舉也招致政界強烈交鋒，保守黨副黨魁Alex Burghart批評工黨企圖揭開歷史傷口以掩蓋經濟失策，改革黨(Reform UK)副黨魁Richard Tice指責政府意圖從後門向布魯塞爾妥協，自由民主黨黨魁Ed Davey則喊話柏南應停止空談，立即就單一市場與關稅同盟開展實質談判。
paras_en: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham told the Labour Party’s annual conference and in subsequent interviews that Brexit has produced "more harm than benefit" and announced the government will begin assessing a range of long‑term options for the UK’s future relationship with the EU. Burnham also admitted that a future Labour election manifesto could "potentially" include a referendum on whether to re‑join the EU.

Burnham said the government aims to present its assessment before the UK‑EU summit in November. The policy pathways he outlined range from maintaining the status quo, borrowing former chancellor George Osborne’s customs‑union proposal, adopting the Liberal Democrats’ single‑market option, or "going all the way" by fully re‑entering the EU.

Burnham stressed that, while now is not the moment to launch a referendum, the UK cannot overcome its development bottlenecks without a long‑term positioning on its biggest trading partner. He also noted that Brexit has actually weakened cooperation on immigration and border control.

London Mayor Sadiq Khan publicly voiced his support, quoting Burnham’s claim that "hope comes from honesty" and condemning Brexit as a "catastrophic act of self‑inflicted harm" in British history. Khan cited research from the London city government showing that Brexit has shrunk London’s economy by about £30 billion and cut nearly two million jobs nationwide.

He urged a Labour government to be the first in this parliamentary term to return to the customs union and single market, and to explain to voters the necessity of re‑joining the EU before the 2029 election.

Institute for Government researcher Jill Rutter analysed that Burnham’s stance marks a clear break from former Labour leader Keir Starmer’s red‑line, formally bringing the "return to the EU" issue back into the political mainstream.

The move has sparked fierce backlash in politics: Conservative deputy leader Alex Burghart accused Labour of reopening old wounds to mask economic missteps, Reform UK deputy leader Richard Tice charged the government with trying to sneak a compromise with Brussels, and Liberal Democrat leader Ed Davey urged Burnham to stop talking and start concrete negotiations on the single market and customs union.

items.title: 明年能產多少油？美伊戰事打亂擴產 OPEC+產能評估被迫延期
items.title_en: How Much Oil Can Be Produced Next Year? US‑Iran Conflict Disrupts Expansion Plans, OPEC+ Capacity Assessment Delayed
paras: 美伊戰爭打亂中東石油擴產計畫，也使主要產油國未來的供應能力更難估算。兩名知情人士向《路透》透露，OPEC+原訂9月底完成、作為2027年原油產量配額協商依據的產能評估已延後，其中一人表示，目前預計11月中旬才能完成。
OPEC+由石油輸出國組織(OPEC)、俄羅斯及其他盟國組成，去年底決定對所有成員進行產能評估，以便在制定2027年配額前，掌握各國可持續生產的原油規模。OPEC尚未立即回應置評要求。
這次評估旨在透過獨立調查，更新各成員的可持續產能數據，而這是協商產量目標的重要依據。然而，美國與以色列對伊朗的戰爭，導致部分OPEC+國家原本可提高產能的計畫延宕，讓預定新增產能能否如期到位充滿變數，也使評估所依據的假設面臨調整。
消息人士表示，並非所有成員都已提交評估所需資料，但未透露哪些國家尚未完成。擴產時程不明，加上資料缺漏，使這項原本就涉及政治角力的工作更加複雜。
評估結果可能直接影響各國未來可生產的原油數量。若一國被認定的產能較低，可能面臨下調配額的壓力；已擴大產能的國家，則可能要求取得更高配額。因此，擴產計畫延誤不僅影響供應潛力，也可能改變成員在配額談判中的立場與籌碼。
配額分配一直是OPEC+內部的敏感議題。阿拉伯聯合大公國先前曾要求提高配額，以反映其持續增加的產能，但已於今年5月退出聯盟。
伊拉克同樣尋求提高配額。消息人士6月曾向《路透》透露，伊拉克也考慮退出OPEC。在成員爭取更大生產空間之際，產能評估延後，為2027年的配額協商增添不確定性。
paras_en: The US‑Iran war has disrupted Middle East oil expansion plans, making it harder to gauge future supply capacity of major producers. Two sources told Reuters that OPEC+’s capacity assessment, originally due by the end of September as the basis for 2027 crude production quota negotiations, has been postponed, with one source saying it is now expected to be completed by mid‑November.

OPEC+, which consists of the Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC), Russia and other allies, decided at the end of last year to conduct a capacity assessment of all members so that, before setting 2027 quotas, it can understand each country’s sustainable crude output. OPEC has not responded to requests for comment.

The assessment aims to update each member’s sustainable capacity figures through an independent survey, providing a key basis for negotiating production targets. However, the US‑Israel war against Iran has delayed some OPEC+ countries’ plans to increase capacity, creating uncertainty over whether the planned additional capacity will materialise and forcing a revision of the assumptions underlying the assessment.

Sources said not all members have submitted the data required for the assessment, but did not specify which countries are still pending. The unclear expansion timeline and missing data make an already politically charged task even more complex.

The assessment results could directly affect how much crude each country can produce in the future. If a country is judged to have lower capacity, it may face pressure to have its quota cut; countries that have expanded capacity may push for higher quotas. Thus, delays in expansion not only affect supply potential but could also shift members’ bargaining positions and leverage in quota talks.

Quota allocation has always been a sensitive issue within OPEC+. The United Arab Emirates previously asked for a higher quota to reflect its ongoing capacity increase, but withdrew from the alliance in May of this year.

Iraq is also seeking a higher quota. Sources told Reuters in June that Iraq was considering leaving OPEC. As members vie for more production space, the delayed capacity assessment adds uncertainty to the 2027 quota negotiations.

items.title: 普丁預言：很快所有人都得開中國車
items.title_en: Putin Predicts: Soon Everyone Will Drive Chinese Cars
paras: 俄羅斯總統普丁1日（周四）在「瓦爾代」國際辯論俱樂部全體會議上表示，由於歐洲汽車市場陷入深度衰退，很快所有車主都可能換開中國車。
普丁說：「歐洲汽車工業在哪裡？企業正在關閉，我們很快都會開上中國車，是好是壞我不知道，但便宜，且品質好。」
普丁駁斥西方國家對中國車「產能過剩」的指責，並提醒市場的基本原則——最終結果永遠由消費者需求決定。
他強調，如今不僅歐洲汽車工業處於深度危機和嚴重困境，歐洲冶金、化工和製藥工業也是如此。
「瓦爾代」國際辯論俱樂部是一個由外國和俄羅斯的政治學、經濟學、歷史學和國際關係領域的頂尖專家組成的協會。
paras_en: Russian President Vladimir Putin said on Thursday, the 1st, at a plenary meeting of the Valday International Debate Club that, due to a deep recession in the European car market, all car owners may soon switch to Chinese vehicles.

Putin stated: "Where is the European automotive industry? Companies are shutting down, and we will soon be driving Chinese cars. I don’t know if it’s good or bad, but they are cheap and of good quality."
Putin dismissed Western accusations of "overcapacity" in Chinese car production and reminded that the basic market principle is that the final outcome is always determined by consumer demand.

He emphasized that not only is the European automotive industry in a deep crisis and severe trouble, but the European metallurgy, chemical and pharmaceutical sectors are likewise facing similar challenges.
The Valday International Debate Club is an association composed of top foreign and Russian experts in political science, economics, history and international relations.

items.title: 川普祭柴油出口禁令威脅！歐盟研議釋出5000萬桶救油價
items.title_en: Trump Threatens Diesel Export Ban; EU Mulls Releasing 50 Million Barrels to Stabilize Prices
paras: 歐洲柴油價格飆升，美國又施壓釋出緊急庫存，歐盟正研議由法國提出的方案，釋出5,000萬桶柴油，並由國際能源署(IEA)成員國另外釋出5,000萬桶原油。歐洲各國也討論，是否要求美方承諾不單方面禁止柴油出口，作為同意釋出庫存的條件。
據《路透》報導，兩名知情人士透露，歐盟各國政府周五(2日)在電話會議中討論這項提案。在此之前，川普政府已要求法國、德國等歐洲大國動用緊急柴油庫存，否則美國可能祭出柴油出口禁令。一名消息人士指出，美方要求這些國家在20天內釋出1億桶柴油。
川普正考慮禁止美國柴油出口，以便在11月3日期中選舉前壓低國內燃料價格。這使歐洲面臨更大壓力：一方面需要抑制燃料成本飆升，另一方面也必須保留緊急儲備，因應美伊戰爭造成的供應中斷，以及波斯灣產油國供油前景的不確定性。法國財政與能源部尚未立即回應置評要求。
全球柴油供應目前受到多重因素衝擊。除了美伊戰爭干擾供應，烏克蘭攻擊造成俄羅斯多座煉油廠受損後，俄方也禁止燃料出口。消息人士另指出，中國煉油業者已暫停10月燃料出口，以充實國內庫存，進一步壓縮國際市場供應。
依歐盟統計局截至2025年5月的資料，法國提議釋出的5,000萬桶柴油，相當於歐盟柴油與輕柴油緊急庫存總量約17%，也約占歐盟全年相關燃料消費量的3%。
歐洲過去主要依賴俄羅斯與中東進口柴油，但近年對美國供應的依賴日益增加。因此，美國一旦禁止柴油出口，歐洲取得替代供應的壓力將進一步升高。
一名知情人士表示，歐盟各國在周五會議中討論，任何釋出柴油庫存的協議，是否都應以美方承諾不單方面實施柴油出口禁令為前提。目前尚未傳出各國已就法國提案達成協議。
該人士另指出，七大工業國集團(G7)領袖可能在周五下午舉行電話會議，討論後續措施。法國目前擔任G7輪值主席國。
IEA的32個成員國已於3月同意協調釋出4億桶戰略石油儲備，以因應美伊戰爭，規模為歷來最大。IEA執行長比羅爾(Fatih Birol)本周表示，成員國迄今已釋出約三分之二的原定數量。
paras_en: Europe’s diesel prices are soaring and the United States is again pressuring the release of emergency stocks. The EU is considering a French‑proposed plan to release 50 million barrels of diesel, while IEA member countries would release another 50 million barrels of crude oil. European governments are also debating whether to demand a U.S. pledge not to unilaterally ban diesel exports as a condition for agreeing to the stock releases.

According to Reuters, two informed sources said EU governments discussed the proposal in a conference call on Friday (the 2nd). Earlier, the Trump administration had asked major European powers such as France and Germany to tap emergency diesel reserves, warning that the U.S. might impose a diesel export ban. One source said the U.S. demanded that these countries release 100 million barrels of diesel within 20 days.

Trump is weighing a ban on U.S. diesel exports to push down domestic fuel prices ahead of the November 3 primary election. This puts Europe under greater strain: it must curb soaring fuel costs while preserving emergency reserves to cope with supply disruptions from the U.S.–Iran conflict and the uncertain outlook for oil supplies from the Persian Gulf. France’s finance and energy ministries have not responded to requests for comment.

Global diesel supply is currently hit by multiple factors. In addition to the U.S.–Iran war disrupting supplies, Russian refineries were damaged by Ukrainian attacks and Russia has banned fuel exports. Sources also note that Chinese refiners have halted October fuel exports to build domestic inventories, further tightening international market supply.

EU statistics as of May 2025 show that the 50 million barrels of diesel France proposes to release represent about 17 % of the EU’s total emergency diesel and light‑diesel stockpiles, roughly 3 % of the bloc’s annual consumption of related fuels.

Europe has traditionally relied on diesel imports from Russia and the Middle East, but its dependence on U.S. supplies has grown in recent years. Consequently, a U.S. diesel export ban would increase pressure on Europe to find alternative sources.

An informed source said EU ministers discussed at Friday’s meeting whether any agreement to release diesel stocks should be predicated on a U.S. commitment not to impose a unilateral diesel export ban. No agreement on the French proposal has been reported yet.
The source added that G7 leaders may hold a conference call on Friday afternoon to discuss follow‑up measures, with France currently holding the G7 rotating presidency.

IEA members, 32 countries, agreed in March to coordinate the release of 400 million barrels of strategic petroleum reserves in response to the U.S.–Iran war – the largest release ever. IEA Executive Director Fatih Birol said this week that members have so far released about two‑thirds of the planned amount.

items.title: 能源震盪推升 歐元區9月通膨率3.8%創3年新高
items.title_en: Energy shock lifts euro area September inflation to 3.8%, a three-year high
paras: 歐元區今年9月消費者物價指數(CPI)年增率飆升至3.8%，高於8月的3.2%，創下自2023年9月以來3年新高，並超越市場預期的3.6%至3.7%，以月率計算，則較8月上漲0.6%。
能源價格暴漲是本次通膨衝高的主要推手，受伊朗戰爭未止持續衝擊石油與天然氣市場影響，9月能源價格年率大漲18.8%(月增3.9%)。能源在消費計算中的權重雖僅約9%，卻為整體通膨貢獻了約1.7個百分點，近乎占據總漲幅的一半。
相對而言，剔除能源與食品的核心通膨率僅微幅升至2.5%，符合預期；服務業通膨率則由3.0%升至3.2%。
區域內四大經濟體物價全面加速升溫，其中義大利年增率升至4.1%、西班牙達到5.0%，全歐元區以立陶宛的6.1%最高，馬爾他的2.4%最低。
目前通膨率已是歐洲央行(ECB)2%目標的近兩倍。然而，考量到公債殖利率飆升已加劇金融環境收緊，加上官員態度審慎，市場預計ECB在10月將暫緩急迫升息，可能延至12月進行最後一次升息。
paras_en: Euro area consumer price index (CPI) year-on-year rose to 3.8% in September, up from 3.2% in August, marking the highest level in three years since September 2023 and beating market expectations of 3.6%–3.7%. On a monthly basis, it increased by 0.6% from August.

The surge in energy prices was the main driver of the inflation spike, as the ongoing war in Iran continued to impact oil and gas markets. In September, energy prices jumped 18.8% year-on-year (up 3.9% month-on-month). Although energy accounts for only about 9% of the consumption basket, it contributed roughly 1.7 percentage points to overall inflation, almost half of the total increase.
By contrast, core inflation, which excludes energy and food, edged up only to 2.5%, in line with expectations; inflation in services rose from 3.0% to 3.2%.

All four major economies in the region saw prices accelerate, with Italy’s annual rate climbing to 4.1%, Spain reaching 5.0%, the euro area’s highest rate at 6.1% in Lithuania, and the lowest at 2.4% in Malta.

The current inflation rate is already nearly twice the European Central Bank’s (ECB) 2% target. However, given the surge in sovereign bond yields that has tightened financial conditions and the cautious stance of officials, markets expect the ECB to pause its aggressive rate hikes in October, possibly postponing the final hike until December.

items.title: 黃仁勳Q3巨星般高調曝光 助攻輝達單季狂飆17% 狠甩標普500
items.title_en: Jensen Huang’s Star‑Power Fuels Nvidia’s Q3 Surge, Outpacing the S&P 500 by 17%
paras: 隨著 2026 年第三季劃下句點，人工智慧龍頭輝達再度以傲人成績驚豔全球資本市場。輝達執行長黃仁勳 (Jensen Huang) 在過去三個月內頻繁曝光，成功轉化為投資人的實質回報。
黃仁勳過去三個月身穿招牌黑色皮衣的身影遍及各大科技峰會、財報會議、媒體專訪，甚至與美國總統川普 (President Trump) 共進餐敘，更豪砸 129 億美元收購知名 AI 平台 Hugging Face。
這股強大的個人魅力與戰略宣示，成功轉化為投資人的實質回報，輝達 (NVDA-US)第三季股價狂飆 17%，遠超標普 500 指數同期 4.3% 的漲幅，今年以來累計漲幅已達 23%。
川普支持 AI 自律 輝達迎來政策利多
黃仁勳週二 (29 日) 出席白宮 AI 午餐會，與科技業領袖討論產業發展及安全監管。與會人士對監管方向立場不一，Anthropic 執行長阿莫戴 (Dario Amodei) 主張加強限制，黃仁勳則支持由業界自律。
川普會後表示，「自我監管非常重要」，並稱讚站在身旁的黃仁勳是「帥氣的傢伙」。
市場分析，川普對產業自律的支持，代表黃仁勳在 AI 監管辯論中取得重要進展，可望有利於輝達長期股價表現。
與會執行長也簽署聲明，承諾維護 AI 技術安全，並遵循自願性原則，包括透過內部控制監督模型開發，以及接受外部模型審查。
對輝達而言，更關鍵的是，會議似乎未提及限制資料中心建設，或限制用於訓練 AI 模型的晶片供應。這項會議結果，有利於輝達持續拓展算力業務。
129 億美元收購 Hugging Face 擴大開發者布局
輝達斥資 129 億美元收購 AI 開發平台 Hugging Face，則是擴大客戶與開發者生態系的重要布局。除了服務大型 AI 公司，輝達也希望讓更多開發者運用其硬體，打造開放模型與各類專業應用。
Rational Equity Armor Fund 投資組合經理 Joe Tigay 分析，若 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 成為主導市場的平台，輝達可以向它們出售算力；但若未來市場由數千個開放模型及專業應用共同組成，Hugging Face 也能讓輝達參與其中。這項策略有助於輝達長期分散客戶來源。
破紀錄 1,500 億美元庫藏股計畫 展現極致財務自信
輝達的強勁表現不僅源於黃仁勳的明星氣場，更有極其紮實的基本面作後盾。
輝達於本週一震撼宣布一項高達 1,500 億美元的股票回購計畫，創下全球歷史上最大規模紀錄，使其總庫藏股授權額度一舉推升至 2,300 億美元，向市場宣告公司對未來現金流與價值的強烈信心。
此外，黃仁勳日前出席高盛全球科技峰會 (Goldman Sachs Communacopia & Tech Conference) 時重申，預計至 2030 年，全球 AI 市場規模將達到 3 兆至 4 兆美元。
而在 8 月的最新財報會議上，黃仁勳更給出令市場驚嘆的前瞻指引：預計 2028 財年營收成長率將高達 70%，遠超華爾街分析師原本預期的 45%。
黃仁勳指出，若非全球記憶體晶片短缺限制了產能，輝達的營收成長率甚至有機會突破 100%。
同業高管盛讚：前所未見的 AI 時代領航者
輝達在 AI 晶片領域的絕對霸主地位，也獲得科技巨頭的高度認同。
雲端巨擘 Salesforce (CRM-US) 執行長馬克·貝尼奧夫 (Marc Benioff) 在本月的 Dreamforce 大會上與黃仁勳同台，並於接受採訪時盛讚：「黃仁勳擁有極少數能打造超大規模資料中心的頂級客戶……輝達最卓越之處，在於他們掌握了這個時代最關鍵的產品，這種競爭優勢在科技史上前所未見。」
隨著生成式 AI 需求持續爆發，輝達憑藉頂尖的硬體實力與戰略佈局，持續鞏固其作為全球 AI 革命核心引擎的無可撼動地位。
從大型資料中心客戶，到 Hugging Face 所連結的開發者與開放模型社群，輝達正持續擴大算力需求來源。隨著白宮支持 AI 產業自律，市場也將關注其產品需求、供應能力與營收展望，能否持續支撐股價表現。
paras_en: As the third quarter of 2026 draws to a close, AI leader Nvidia once again dazzles global capital markets with stellar results. CEO Jensen Huang has been in the spotlight constantly over the past three months, turning that visibility into tangible returns for investors.

In the past three months Huang, clad in his signature black leather jacket, has appeared at major tech summits, earnings briefings and media interviews, even dining with President Trump and splurging $12.9 billion to acquire the well‑known AI platform Hugging Face.

That potent mix of personal charisma and strategic signaling has translated into real investor gains: Nvidia (NVDA‑US) stock jumped 17% in Q3, far outpacing the S&P 500’s 4.3% gain for the same period, and up 23% year‑to‑date so far.
Trump backs AI self‑regulation, giving Nvidia a policy tailwind

On Tuesday the 29th, Huang attended a White House AI lunch, discussing industry development and safety regulation with tech leaders. Participants were split on regulatory stance, with Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei urging tighter limits while Huang advocated industry self‑governance.
After the meeting, Trump said “self‑regulation is very important” and praised the man beside him as a “handsome guy.”
Analysts note that Trump’s endorsement of industry self‑regulation marks a significant win for Huang in the AI‑regulation debate and could benefit Nvidia’s long‑term share performance.
The attending CEOs also signed a pledge to safeguard AI safety and follow voluntary principles, including internal controls over model development and external model audits.

For Nvidia, the key takeaway is that the meeting did not raise any caps on data‑center construction or on chips used to train AI models, a result that favours Nvidia’s continued expansion of its compute business.
$12.9 billion acquisition of Hugging Face expands developer footprint

Nvidia’s $12.9 billion purchase of the AI development platform Hugging Face is a major step in broadening its customer and developer ecosystem. Beyond serving large AI firms, Nvidia hopes to enable more developers to use its hardware to build open models and a variety of specialised applications.

Rational Equity Armor Fund portfolio manager Joe Tigay explains that if OpenAI and Anthropic dominate the market, Nvidia can sell them compute power; but if the future market consists of thousands of open models and niche applications, Hugging Face will let Nvidia participate in that ecosystem, diversifying its customer base over the long term.
Record‑breaking $150 billion share‑repurchase plan showcases extreme financial confidence
Nvidia’s impressive performance stems not only from Huang’s star power but also from rock‑solid fundamentals.

Nvidia shocked the market on Monday by announcing a $150 billion stock buyback, the largest ever in history, raising its total authorised treasury‑stock limit to $230 billion and signalling strong confidence in future cash flow and valuation.
At the Goldman Sachs Communacopia & Tech Conference, Huang reiterated his forecast that the global AI market will reach $3‑4 trillion by 2030.
In the August earnings call, Huang gave a bold forward‑looking guide: fiscal‑year‑2028 revenue growth is expected to hit 70%, far above Wall Street’s 45% consensus.
Huang added that absent the global memory‑chip shortage that now limits capacity, Nvidia’s revenue growth could even break the 100% mark.
Peers laud him as an unprecedented AI‑era trailblazer
Nvidia’s undisputed dominance in AI chips has earned high praise from other tech giants.

Salesforce (CRM‑US) CEO Marc Benioff shared the stage with Huang at this month’s Dreamforce conference and, in an interview, praised him: “Huang is one of the few who can build ultra‑large‑scale data centres for top‑tier customers… Nvidia’s greatest strength is that it controls the most critical product of this era; that competitive edge is unprecedented in tech history.”
With generative‑AI demand exploding, Nvidia’s top‑tier hardware and strategic positioning continue to cement its unshakable role as the core engine of the global AI revolution.

From massive data‑center customers to the developer and open‑model community linked through Hugging Face, Nvidia is constantly expanding sources of compute demand. With the White House backing AI industry self‑regulation, the market will watch product demand, supply capacity and revenue outlook to see if they can sustain the stock’s performance.

items.title: 川普憂弱勢日元衝擊美貿易 高市：日元低估本身就是問題
items.title_en: Trump Worried Weak Yen Threatens US Trade; Kōchi: Yen Undervaluation Is a Problem in Itself
paras: 日本首相高市早苗周四(1日)透露，她上個月在紐約與美國總統川普會談時，被告知日元疲弱正導致美國貿易面臨困境。
高市接受日本電視台(NTV)獨家專訪，被問到美日雙方是否就如何處理日元疲弱問題取得一致時，她說：「在日美領袖會談中，對方提到美國貿易因日元疲弱而面臨困難，我則回應，按照一般原則，日元被低估本身就是一個問題。」
高市並透露與財務大臣片山皐月對談時獲悉，美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)曾表示，他理解日本政府的經濟政策，也沒有就政策方向提出任何要求。
她在周四晚間播出的專訪中說：「我們在繼續負責任且積極的財政政策下，追求強健經濟與永續財政的想法並沒有改變。」
川普政府近來罕見頻頻表達對日元疲弱的關切。貝森特多次暗示，日本銀行(央行，BOJ)應升息，以協助日元找到適當價位。他在德州一所大學演講時曾說，他對日本政策制定者接下來的行動「相當有把握」，甚至向投機客嗆聲「我是莊家」，要求他們押注日元貶值、與他對作。
先前日元兌美元貶至164附近之後，日美當局曾共同介入外匯市場，是雙方美日28年來首次聯手支撐日元。川普當時形容，這項干預是友誼的象徵。
日本官員通常會淡化美方言論對日本政策制定方面的影響。高市在專訪中避免對外匯市場做出具體評論，轉而談及她對經濟振興的願景，強調這將有助於支撐日元。
她說：「我們希望透過大膽投資風險管理與成長領域，提高日本潛在經濟成長率並強化供應能力，以實現強健經濟。我相信，提高日本經濟的競爭力，最終將有助於建立對日元的信心。」
paras_en: Japanese Prime Minister Naoto Kōchi said on Thursday (the 1st) that during her meeting with US President Donald Trump in New York last month, she was told that a weak yen is causing difficulties for US trade.

In an exclusive interview with Japan's NTV, when asked whether the US and Japan had reached a consensus on how to handle the weak yen, she said: “During the US‑Japan leaders’ talks, the US side mentioned that American trade is facing challenges because of the weak yen. I responded that, as a general principle, an undervalued yen is itself a problem.”

Kōchi also revealed that in a conversation with Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama she learned that US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent had said he understands Japan’s economic policy and has not made any demands regarding its direction.
In the interview aired Thursday evening she said: “Our commitment to responsible and proactive fiscal policy, and our pursuit of a strong economy and sustainable finances, remains unchanged.”

The Trump administration has lately expressed unusually frequent concern over the weak yen. Bessent has repeatedly hinted that the Bank of Japan should raise rates to help the yen find an appropriate level. Speaking at a Texas university, he said he is “quite confident” about the next steps Japanese policymakers will take and even taunted speculators, saying “I’m the house” and urging them to bet on yen depreciation in line with his view.

After the yen fell to around 164 per dollar, US and Japanese authorities jointly intervened in the foreign‑exchange market – the first US‑Japan coordinated support for the yen in 28 years. Trump at the time described the intervention as a symbol of friendship.

Japanese officials usually downplay the impact of US statements on Japan’s policy‑making. In the interview Kōchi avoided specific comments on the FX market, instead discussing her vision for economic revitalisation and stressing that it would help support the yen.

She said: “We aim to boost Japan’s potential growth rate and strengthen supply capacity through bold investment, risk management and growth‑sector focus, to achieve a robust economy. I believe that enhancing Japan’s competitiveness will ultimately help build confidence in the yen.”

items.title: 軟銀完成OpenAI 300億美元追投資金 累計持股達13%
items.title_en: SoftBank Completes $30 B OpenAI Follow‑On Investment, Holding 13% Stake
paras: 日本投資巨頭軟銀集團宣布，已透過旗下「願景基金 2號」(Vision Fund 2)完成對 OpenAI 最後一筆 100 億美元的挹注，正式實現今年 2 月承諾的 300 億美元追加投資。
此輪融資共分三期執行，在執行長阿特曼(Sam Altman)領軍下，OpenAI 此前在最新一輪融資中獲得高達 1,220 億美元的認購承諾，公司估值衝上 8,520 億美元，並由軟銀、亞馬遜(AMZN-US)與輝達(NVDA-US)共同領投。
隨著最後一筆資金到位，軟銀對這家 ChatGPT 開發商的累計投資金額已達 646 億美元，取得 OpenAI 約 13% 的股權。
為了支應這筆龐大資金，軟銀上月透過全球最大規模的高收益外幣公司債發行籌集了 111 億美元。此外，軟銀宣布取消先前 400 億美元橋式貸款中剩餘的 100 億美元未引用額度，相關借款已全數還清。
針對軟銀的重金佈局，再次凸顯創辦人孫正義強勢推動人工智慧產業發展的雄心，OpenAI 已成為軟銀旗下最大的投資標的之一。
然而，市場與投資人對其 AI 投資規模及龐大融資壓力抱持審視態度。東京股市周五(2日)，軟銀集團股價重挫 5.83%，跌至 6,310 日元。
paras_en: Japanese investment giant SoftBank Group announced that it has completed the final $10 billion tranche to OpenAI through its Vision Fund 2, officially fulfilling the $30 billion additional investment pledged in February.

The financing was executed in three phases; under CEO Sam Altman, OpenAI previously secured up to $122 billion in subscription commitments in its latest round, pushing the company’s valuation to $852 billion, with SoftBank, Amazon (AMZN‑US) and Nvidia (NVDA‑US) as lead investors.
With the last tranche now in place, SoftBank’s cumulative investment in the ChatGPT developer totals $64.6 billion, giving it roughly a 13% equity stake in OpenAI.

To fund the massive outlay, SoftBank raised $11.1 billion last month through the world’s largest high‑yield foreign‑currency corporate bond issuance, and it also announced the cancellation of the remaining $10 billion of a previously arranged $40 billion bridge loan, fully repaying the related borrowing.
SoftBank’s heavy‑handed positioning underscores founder Masayoshi Son’s aggressive push to develop the AI industry, making OpenAI one of the Group’s largest investment targets.

Nevertheless, markets and investors remain cautious about the scale of its AI spending and the financing pressure; on Friday (the 2nd), SoftBank’s shares plunged 5.83% on the Tokyo exchange, falling to ¥6,310.

items.title: 〈台幣〉亞幣轉強！逆勢翻升收31.83元 觀望美非農報告
items.title_en: TWD: Asian Currencies Strengthen! Defying Trend, Rises to 31.83, Awaiting US Nonfarm Payrolls
paras: 市場關注美國稍晚即將公布的非農就業數據，台北匯市整體交投轉趨冷清，新台幣兌美元今 (2) 日盤中一度貶破 31.9 元關卡，外資雙向進出，但整體亞幣偏升，尾盤在央行調節下，新台幣終場以31.83元作收，小升1.2分，為連 3 升，台北與元太外匯總成交值萎縮至 21.91 億美元。
台北股匯本周僅有四個交易日，由於美伊衝突未見緩解，使得美元本周較為強勢，新台幣兌美元累計貶值5分或0.16%，周線再度翻黑。
台股電子權值股今(2)日多無表態，早盤呈現震盪走勢，但被動元件、光通訊、PCB、矽晶圓等中小型股接棒演出，帶動大盤走揚，最高漲至48491.62點，距盤中歷史新高 48601.53 點僅差臨門一腳，終場漲 122.25 點，收 48475.74 點，仍寫收盤新高，成交量8981.74億元。外資今天買超台股 26.22 億元。
新台幣兌美元今天開盤價為 31.87 元，盤中一度貶近 1 角，最低來到 31.935 元，不過，為避免新台幣走勢與主要亞幣脫鉤太多，央行適時進場調節，帶動匯價由貶轉升，收在 31.83 元。
觀察主要貨幣今天表現，根據央行統計，韓元強升 1.13%，成為本日最強亞幣，日元亦勁揚 0.51%，星幣升值 0.15%，新台幣小升 0.04%，人民幣則因十一長假休市。
周三數據顯示，美國8月通膨增幅低於預期，且7月數據遭到下修，降低了市場對聯準會本月升息的預期。市場將焦點轉向美國勞工統計局 (BLS) 即將公布的 9 月非農就業報告，這將是Fed 評估下一步利率政策的重要依據。
paras_en: The market is focused on the U.S. non‑farm payroll data that will be released later today. Taipei’s foreign‑exchange market turned relatively quiet, and the New Taiwan dollar slipped below the 31.9 per USD mark during the session. Foreign investors were active on both sides, but overall Asian currencies were on the rise. In the final minutes, after central‑bank intervention, the TWD closed at 31.83 per USD, a modest gain of 0.12 and the third consecutive rise. The total turnover in the Taipei and Yuan‑Tai foreign‑exchange market shrank to $2.191 billion.

Taipei’s stock and FX market had only four trading days this week. Because the U.S.–Iran conflict showed no sign of easing, the dollar remained relatively strong, and the TWD/USD pair depreciated a cumulative 5 ticks, or 0.16%, turning the weekly chart back into the red.

Taiwan’s heavyweight electronic stocks gave little guidance today, with the early session showing a choppy range. However, small‑ and mid‑cap stocks in passive components, optical communications, PCBs and silicon wafers took the lead, lifting the index to a high of 48,491.62 points—just 110 points shy of the intraday record of 48,601.53. The market closed up 122.25 points at 48,475.74, still posting a new closing high, with a turnover of NT$898.174 billion. Foreign investors were net buyers of NT$2.622 billion of Taiwan equities today.

The New Taiwan dollar opened at 31.87 per USD and fell nearly 0.10 during the session, reaching a low of 31.935. To prevent the TWD from drifting too far from the major Asian currencies, the central bank stepped in, turning the depreciation into appreciation and ending the day at 31.83.

items.title: 川普憂弱勢日元衝擊美貿易 高市：日元低估本身就是問題
items.title_en: Trump Worried Weak Yen Threatens US Trade; Kōchi: Yen Undervaluation Is a Problem in Itself
paras: 日本首相高市早苗周四(1日)透露，她上個月在紐約與美國總統川普會談時，被告知日元疲弱正導致美國貿易面臨困境。
高市接受日本電視台(NTV)獨家專訪，被問到美日雙方是否就如何處理日元疲弱問題取得一致時，她說：「在日美領袖會談中，對方提到美國貿易因日元疲弱而面臨困難，我則回應，按照一般原則，日元被低估本身就是一個問題。」
高市並透露與財務大臣片山皐月對談時獲悉，美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)曾表示，他理解日本政府的經濟政策，也沒有就政策方向提出任何要求。
她在周四晚間播出的專訪中說：「我們在繼續負責任且積極的財政政策下，追求強健經濟與永續財政的想法並沒有改變。」
川普政府近來罕見頻頻表達對日元疲弱的關切。貝森特多次暗示，日本銀行(央行，BOJ)應升息，以協助日元找到適當價位。他在德州一所大學演講時曾說，他對日本政策制定者接下來的行動「相當有把握」，甚至向投機客嗆聲「我是莊家」，要求他們押注日元貶值、與他對作。
先前日元兌美元貶至164附近之後，日美當局曾共同介入外匯市場，是雙方美日28年來首次聯手支撐日元。川普當時形容，這項干預是友誼的象徵。
日本官員通常會淡化美方言論對日本政策制定方面的影響。高市在專訪中避免對外匯市場做出具體評論，轉而談及她對經濟振興的願景，強調這將有助於支撐日元。
她說：「我們希望透過大膽投資風險管理與成長領域，提高日本潛在經濟成長率並強化供應能力，以實現強健經濟。我相信，提高日本經濟的競爭力，最終將有助於建立對日元的信心。」
paras_en: Japanese Prime Minister Naoto Kōchi said on Thursday (the 1st) that during her meeting with US President Donald Trump in New York last month, she was told that a weak yen is causing difficulties for US trade.

In an exclusive interview with Japan's NTV, when asked whether the US and Japan had reached a consensus on how to handle the weak yen, she said: “During the US‑Japan leaders’ talks, the US side mentioned that American trade is facing challenges because of the weak yen. I responded that, as a general principle, an undervalued yen is itself a problem.”

Kōchi also revealed that in a conversation with Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama she learned that US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent had said he understands Japan’s economic policy and has not made any demands regarding its direction.
In the interview aired Thursday evening she said: “Our commitment to responsible and proactive fiscal policy, and our pursuit of a strong economy and sustainable finances, remains unchanged.”

The Trump administration has lately expressed unusually frequent concern over the weak yen. Bessent has repeatedly hinted that the Bank of Japan should raise rates to help the yen find an appropriate level. Speaking at a Texas university, he said he is “quite confident” about the next steps Japanese policymakers will take and even taunted speculators, saying “I’m the house” and urging them to bet on yen depreciation in line with his view.

After the yen fell to around 164 per dollar, US and Japanese authorities jointly intervened in the foreign‑exchange market – the first US‑Japan coordinated support for the yen in 28 years. Trump at the time described the intervention as a symbol of friendship.

Japanese officials usually downplay the impact of US statements on Japan’s policy‑making. In the interview Kōchi avoided specific comments on the FX market, instead discussing her vision for economic revitalisation and stressing that it would help support the yen.

She said: “We aim to boost Japan’s potential growth rate and strengthen supply capacity through bold investment, risk management and growth‑sector focus, to achieve a robust economy. I believe that enhancing Japan’s competitiveness will ultimately help build confidence in the yen.”

items.title: 東京9月核心CPI漲2.7%超預期 支持升息預期
items.title_en: Tokyo September Core CPI Rises 2.7% Beyond Expectations, Supporting Rate‑Hike Outlook
paras: 日本總務省公布9月東京都區部排除生鮮食品的核心消費者物價指數，年增率達2.7%，高於市場預期的2.3%至2.4%，為連續第4個月擴大增幅，並創下8個月來首次重返2%上方。排除生鮮食品與能源後的雙核心CPI年增率更攀升至3.0%。
由於東京數據為日本全國物價的先行指標，數據公布後日元應聲走強，美元兌日元匯率跌破158關卡。
總務省說明，本次物價推升主因包含幼兒托育免費效應減退、基本水費免費政策結束，以及連假效應拉高住宿與旅遊費用；此外，晶片價格上漲與AI需求帶動電腦等娛樂耐久財價格走高。
針對通膨動向，國際通貨研究所上席研究員久後翔太郎表示，雖然幼兒托育等特殊政策影響顯著，但「剔除一時性因素後，基底物價的上揚壓力持續增強並未改變」。他認為這將支持日本央行加快升息步調，年內再次升息「幾乎無庸置疑」，若日元急貶，甚至不排除於10月動手。
彭博經濟學資深經濟學家木村太郎則指出，數據超預期主要是政策因素推高，「物價基調並非驟然改變」。但他補充說明，能源價格上漲、日元貶值及人工成本增加正波及廣泛品項，基底通膨動能仍相當強勁。
日本央行已於9月會議將政策利率調升至1.25%，總裁植田和男先前強調政策進入「局面變化」，對進一步升息抱持正面態度。目前利率交換市場已幾乎完全預估12月前將再次升息。
paras_en: Japan's Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications reported that the core consumer price index for Tokyo’s metropolitan area in September, excluding fresh food, rose 2.7% year‑on‑year, above the market forecast of 2.3%‑2.4%. This marks the fourth consecutive month of accelerating growth and the first time in eight months that the rate has returned above 2%. The “double‑core” CPI, which also excludes energy, climbed to a 3.0% annual increase.
Because Tokyo’s data is seen as a leading indicator for Japan’s nationwide inflation, the yen strengthened after the release, with the dollar‑yen rate slipping below the 158 level.

The ministry explained that the price rise was driven mainly by the waning effect of free childcare for infants, the end of a policy providing free basic water, and a holiday‑related surge in accommodation and travel costs. In addition, higher chip prices and AI‑driven demand lifted the prices of computers and other entertainment‑durable goods.

Commenting on the inflation trend, senior researcher Shōtarō Kuho of the International Monetary Research Institute said that although special policies such as free childcare have a noticeable impact, “once temporary factors are stripped out, the upward pressure on underlying prices continues to intensify and has not changed.” He believes this will support the Bank of Japan in accelerating its rate‑hike pace, making another hike within the year “almost a certainty,” and if the yen were to depreciate sharply, a move as early as October cannot be ruled out.

Senior Bloomberg economist Taro Kimura noted that the data beating expectations was mainly due to policy‑related factors and that “the overall price trend has not suddenly shifted.” He added that rising energy prices, yen depreciation and higher labor costs are affecting a broad range of items, keeping core inflation momentum still very strong.

The Bank of Japan raised its policy rate to 1.25% at its September meeting. Governor Kazuo Ueda had previously emphasized that policy was entering a “changing landscape” and expressed a positive stance toward further hikes. The interest‑rate swap market now almost fully prices in another rate increase before December.

items.title: Fed蘿根：至少應再升息2碼  並需連番升息來抵銷去年秋季降息
items.title_en: Fed Logan: At Least Two More Rate Hikes Needed, With Consecutive Increases to Counter Last Fall’s Cuts
paras: 達拉斯聯準銀行總裁蘿根(Lorie Logan)週四(1日)表示，聯準會(Fed)至少應該再升息2碼(50個基點)。
她在一場演講中話道：「聯準會的政策立場一直偏離正軌，聯準會應該升息，目標至少為加50個基點。且至少需要進一步升息數次，才能抵銷去年秋季的降息，因為若無較高的利率，通膨無法達到聯準會2%目標。」
蘿根還表示，長債殖利率走高顯示市場參與者預期未來利率水準更高，她將密切關注美債殖利率走勢並評估其對經濟、融資成本和貨幣政策的影響。
她認為，長端殖利率上升未必只來自政策預期，也可能反映期限溢價走高。若投資人要求更高補償、期限溢價上升，會自然推高借貸成本，在一定程度上取代Fed緊縮，進而降低進一步升息的必要性。
但蘿根強調，Fed不會僅因長債殖利率上漲就預設行動，而會結合通膨、就業與金融環境判斷。
蘿根曾在2023年的演講中詳細介紹她所參考的各類美債市場模型。她表示，會持續觀察殖利率走勢以及經濟其他方面，以此判斷何種利率水準能對經濟形成一定抑制效果。
蘿根今年在聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)是擁有投票資格的決策官員，但作為地區聯準銀行總裁，她的言論仍被視為政策方向的重要參考。
paras_en: Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan said on Thursday (the 1st) that the Federal Reserve should raise rates by at least two more increments, equivalent to 50 basis points.

In her speech she said, “The Fed’s policy stance has been off track; the Fed should raise rates, targeting at least an additional 50 basis points. Several more hikes will be needed to offset the rate cuts made last autumn, because without higher rates inflation cannot reach the Fed’s 2% goal.”

Logan also noted that rising long‑term bond yields indicate market participants expect higher future rates, and she will closely monitor U.S. Treasury yield movements and assess their impact on the economy, financing costs, and monetary policy.

She argued that the rise in long‑end yields may not stem solely from policy expectations; it could also reflect a higher term premium. If investors demand greater compensation and term premiums rise, borrowing costs will naturally increase, partially substituting for Fed tightening and reducing the need for further hikes.
Nonetheless, Logan emphasized that the Fed will not act solely on higher long‑term yields; decisions will be based on a combination of inflation, employment, and financial‑market conditions.

Logan previously detailed the various Treasury‑market models she follows in a 2023 speech, saying she will continue to watch yield trends and other economic indicators to gauge what level of rates can exert a sufficient restraining effect on the economy.

Logan is a voting member of the Federal Open Market Committee this year, and although she serves as a regional Fed president, her comments are still regarded as an important reference for the direction of policy.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉全球債券拋售推升美元 歐元承壓
items.title_en: New York FX: Global Bond Sell‑off Boosts Dollar, Euro Under Pressure
paras: 美元周四(1日)上漲，兌歐元周四升至17個月高點，全球債券遭遇拋售，推動美國與歐洲政府公債殖利率升至新高，同時油價上漲也加劇市場對通膨的擔憂。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.51%，盤中一度升至2025年4月以來最高水準。
截至9月底，美元兌一籃子貨幣已連續第6季上漲，創下2022年以來最長連漲紀錄。2022年期間，美國升息速度快於其他國家。
歐元兌美元跌破1.1215美元，為2025年5月以來首次。過去幾個月美元持續走強，部分原因是美國公債殖利率出現自1994年以來最大單季升幅。
歐元兌美元下跌0.77%，至1.12433美元。歐元9月下跌近2.5%，創下2025年7月以來最大單月跌幅。
NatWest Markets G10外匯策略主管Brian Daingerfield表示，「殖利率走高是多項因素共同作用的結果，尤其是市場對財政政策的擔憂，包括法國債券市場出現部分疲弱跡象，可能正蔓延至全球市場。此外，市場也持續擔心能源價格與通膨走高。」
他指出，「市場預期各國央行將持續收緊政策，其中也包括聯準會(Fed)。過去幾天，在我們昨天公布的部分個人消費支出(PCE)數據公布後，這種預期有所回落。但整體而言，市場普遍認為聯準會可能還會進一步收緊政策。」
美國10年期公債殖利率當日升至2002年以來最高水準，最新下跌5.65個基點至5.237%。
歐元兌日元與瑞郎也同步下跌，兌英鎊則勉強維持正值。法國政府財政狀況不穩引發市場擔憂，推動法國公債殖利率飆升至14年新高。德國指標性公債也遭到拋售。
Klarity FX總監Amo Sahota表示，「幾周以來，美元一直持續走強，而市場時不時就會出現一個新的敘事，為美元提供進一步上漲的動力。」
「但我認為最新的這個因素可能是最令人擔憂的，也就是歐洲市場出現恐慌。法國債務實在太高，加上法國與德國之間的利差擴大，讓所有人都感到不安。歐元因此大幅走弱，而且跌勢再次加速。」
周三公布數據顯示，美國8月通膨增幅低於預期，且7月數據遭到下修，降低了市場對聯準會本月升息的預期。不過，歐元區通膨大幅上升，凸顯能源價格上漲持續對全球經濟構成威脅。
全球債券在9月出現多年來最大單月跌幅，推動殖利率走高，原因包括政府財政狀況惡化、公債發行供給過多，以及通膨升溫等多項因素。
英鎊兌美元下跌0.49%，至1.32美元。英鎊9月下跌2.1%，但兌歐元持穩。歐元兌英鎊約報85.18便士，為6月底以來最低水準。
日元兌美元貶值0.41%，至每美元158.07日元。

paras_en: The dollar rose on Thursday (the 1st), reaching a 17‑month high against the euro as a global bond sell‑off pushed U.S. and European government bond yields to fresh highs, while higher oil prices heightened market inflation concerns.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.51% and at one point hit its highest level since April 2025.

As of the end of September, the dollar against a basket of currencies has risen for six consecutive quarters, marking the longest streak of gains since 2022. During 2022, U.S. rate hikes outpaced those of other countries.

The euro fell below $1.1215, its first dip below that level since May 2025. The dollar’s recent strength over the past months has been partly driven by a quarterly surge in U.S. Treasury yields—the largest since 1994.
The euro slipped 0.77% to $1.12433. In September the euro fell nearly 2.5%, the biggest monthly decline since July 2025.

NatWest Markets G10 FX strategy head Brian Daingerfield said, “Higher yields are the result of multiple factors, especially market worries about fiscal policy, including signs of weakness in the French bond market that could be spreading globally. In addition, markets remain concerned about rising energy prices and inflation.”

He added, “Markets expect central banks worldwide to keep tightening policy, including the Fed. In the past few days, after some personal consumption expenditures (PCE) data we released yesterday, that expectation eased a bit. Overall, however, the market broadly believes the Fed may still tighten further.”
U.S. 10‑year Treasury yields rose to their highest level since 2002 on the day, later easing 5.65 basis points to 5.237%.

The euro also fell against the yen and the Swiss franc, while it barely stayed positive against the pound. Concerns over France’s fiscal situation have spooked markets, sending French bond yields to a 14‑year high, and German benchmark bonds have also been sold off.
Klarity FX director Amo Sahota said, “For weeks the dollar has been consistently strong, and the market keeps coming up with new narratives that give the dollar further upside.”

“But I think the latest factor may be the most worrying—panic in European markets. French debt is simply too high, and the widening spread between France and Germany is unsettling everyone. The euro has therefore weakened sharply, and the decline is accelerating again.”

Wednesday’s data showed U.S. August inflation rose less than expected, and July’s figure was revised down, lowering market expectations for a Fed rate hike this month. However, euro‑area inflation surged, underscoring that rising energy prices continue to threaten the global economy.

Global bonds posted their biggest monthly drop in years in September, pushing yields higher. The drivers include deteriorating fiscal positions, an oversupply of sovereign debt, and warming inflation, among other factors.
The pound fell 0.49% to $1.32. It is down 2.1% in September but held steady against the euro. The euro‑pound rate is about 85.18 pence, the lowest since the end of June.
The yen weakened 0.41% to ¥158.07 per dollar.
The Australian dollar slipped to $0.69040, a three‑month low, after domestic inflation data came in below expectations.

items.title_en: TWD Q4 Opening Red! Market Hits New High, Currency Falls Then Rises to 31.842
paras: 今(1)日為第四季第一個交易日，呈現股匯齊揚走勢，大盤寫下史上收盤新高 48353.49 點，不過，新台幣兌美元先貶後升，一度貶近 1 角，失守 31.9 元關卡，終場在央行稍加調節下，以小升 1 分、31.842元作收，台北及元太外匯市場總成交值 25.58 億美元。
台股今天開高震盪，雖一度翻黑，但在外資回頭買超下，漲勢逐漸放大，加權指數終場上漲413.36點，收在48353.49點，創下收盤新高，外資全日買超 219.37億元。台積電、聯發科等大型權值股普遍上漲，被動元件與 PCB 族群也成為盤面最吸金焦點。
新台幣兌美元今天開盤價為31.87元，最高來到31.842元、最低下探31.946元，外資呈現雙向進出，央行則稍加調節，終場貶勢明顯收斂，收在 31.842元、小升1分。
觀察主要貨幣今天對美元表現，根據央行統計，美元指數上漲 0.45%，日元重貶 0.95%，韓元同步貶值 0.75%，星幣貶值 0.28%，新台幣則小升 0.03%。人民幣適逢十一長假休市。
美國通膨指標個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數月增 0.3%，低於市場預期 0.4%。根據CME的FedWatch工具，交易員目前預期聯準會10月升息的機率為37%，低於一周前的70%。
paras_en: Today is the first trading day of the fourth quarter, showing a rally in both stocks and the exchange rate. The index closed at a historic high of 48,353.49 points. However, the New Taiwan dollar against the US dollar first depreciated then appreciated, slipping nearly 0.1 NT$ and breaking the 31.9 NT$ barrier, before ending at a modest 0.01 NT$ rise to 31.842 NT$ under a slight adjustment by the central bank, with total foreign‑exchange turnover in Taipei and Yuan‑Tai markets reaching US$2.558 billion.

The Taiwan stock market opened higher but volatile, briefly turning negative before foreign investors returned to net buying, expanding the rally. The weighted index finished up 413.36 points at 48,353.49, a new closing high, with foreign investors net buying NT$21.937 billion for the day. Large‑cap stocks such as TSMC and MediaTek rose across the board, and passive component and PCB groups became the market’s biggest money magnets.

The New Taiwan dollar opened at 31.87 NT$ per US$, peaked at 31.842 NT$, and fell to a low of 31.946 NT$. Foreign investors showed two‑way flows, while the central bank made a slight adjustment, narrowing the depreciation trend and closing at 31.842 NT$, a modest 0.01 NT$ increase.

Looking at major currencies against the US dollar, central‑bank data show the US Dollar Index up 0.45%, the Japanese yen down 0.95%, the Korean won down 0.75%, the Singapore dollar down 0.28%, and the New Taiwan dollar up 0.03%. The Chinese yuan was closed for the National Day holiday.

US inflation data showed the personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index rising 0.3% month‑over‑month, below the market expectation of 0.4%. According to CME’s FedWatch tool, traders now assign a 37% probability to a Fed rate hike in October, down from 70% a week earlier.

items.title: 高通膨與利率走升雙重打擊 歐元下探17個月新低
items.title_en: Dual Blow from Rising Inflation and Interest Rates Sends Euro to 17‑Month Low
paras: 受高油價與通膨打擊區域經濟、加上政治不確定性升溫影響，歐元兌美元匯率周四(1日)跌至 17 個月新低，跌破 1.13 美元關卡。
9 月份歐元累計重挫近 2.5%，創下 2025 年 7 月以來最大單月跌幅。同時，歐元兌日元與瑞士法郎同步走弱，法國公債殖利率飆升至 14 年新高，德國指標債券也面臨拋售壓力。
對於歐元的疲軟表現，荷蘭合作銀行(Rabobank)外匯策略主管 Jane Foley 指出，經濟成長風險長期籠罩歐元。Foley 表示：「儘管歐洲央行是G10中最早升息的央行之一，且市場預期將再度升息，但歐元仍無法獲得支撐力道。」
她補充，歐元主要受到多頭部位累積過高、歐洲作為能源進口國的隱憂，以及延伸至明年的政治不確定性(如法國大選與德國右翼政黨崛起)所拖累。
相較之下，受惠於美債殖利率急升，美元指數創下自 2022 年以來最長的連續六季上漲紀錄。澳洲國民銀行(National Australia Bank)外匯策略主管 Ray Attrill 表示：「目前美元對 10 年期美國公債殖利率變化的敏感度，高於對聯準會(Fed)下次升息時點的定價。」
Attrill 指出，殖利率持續上升對美元構成支撐，若殖利率升至轉折點並衝擊股市，美元也能發揮避險效益。
paras_en: The euro fell to a 17‑month low against the dollar on Thursday (the 1st), slipping below the 1.13 USD mark, as regional economies are hit by high oil prices and inflation, and political uncertainty heats up.

In September the euro accumulated a near‑2.5% decline, the biggest monthly drop since July 2025. At the same time the euro weakened against the yen and the Swiss franc, French government bond yields surged to a 14‑year high, and German benchmark bonds faced selling pressure.

Regarding the euro’s weakness, Jane Foley, head of foreign‑exchange strategy at Rabobank, said the risk to economic growth has long cast a shadow over the currency. Foley noted, “Even though the ECB is one of the earliest G10 central banks to raise rates and markets expect another hike, the euro still lacks support.”

She added that the euro is being dragged down by an overly large buildup of long‑position bets, Europe’s vulnerability as an energy‑importing region, and political uncertainty extending into next year, such as the French election and the rise of right‑wing parties in Germany.

In contrast, the dollar index has set a record for the longest six‑quarter streak of gains since 2022, helped by a sharp rise in U.S. Treasury yields. Ray Attrill, head of foreign‑exchange strategy at National Australia Bank, said, “Right now the dollar’s sensitivity to changes in the 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield is greater than its pricing of the Fed’s next rate‑hike timing.”
Attrill pointed out that continued yield increases underpin the dollar; if yields reach a turning point and hit equity markets, the dollar can also serve as a safe‑haven asset.
